            float val;
            float min_dist = 999999.0f;
            float sx = (float) x + 0.5f;
            float sy = (float) y + 0.5f;
            float x_gspace = (sx / scale_x);
            float y_gspace = (sy / scale_y);

            int winding = stbtt__compute_crossings_x(x_gspace, y_gspace, num_verts, verts); // @OPTIMIZE: this could just be a rasterization, but needs to be line vs. non-tesselated curves so a new path

            for (i=0; i < num_verts; ++i) {
               float x0 = verts[i].x*scale_x, y0 = verts[i].y*scale_y;

               if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vline && precompute[i] != 0.0f) {
                  float x1 = verts[i-1].x*scale_x, y1 = verts[i-1].y*scale_y;

                  float dist,dist2 = (x0-sx)*(x0-sx) + (y0-sy)*(y0-sy);
                  if (dist2 < min_dist*min_dist)
                     min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);

                  // coarse culling against bbox
                  //if (sx > STBTT_min(x0,x1)-min_dist && sx < STBTT_max(x0,x1)+min_dist &&
                  //    sy > STBTT_min(y0,y1)-min_dist && sy < STBTT_max(y0,y1)+min_dist)
                  dist = (float) STBTT_fabs((x1-x0)*(y0-sy) - (y1-y0)*(x0-sx)) * precompute[i];
                  STBTT_assert(i != 0);
                  if (dist < min_dist) {
                     // check position along line
                     // x' = x0 + t*(x1-x0), y' = y0 + t*(y1-y0)
                     // minimize (x'-sx)*(x'-sx)+(y'-sy)*(y'-sy)
                     float dx = x1-x0, dy = y1-y0;
                     float px = x0-sx, py = y0-sy;
                     // minimize (px+t*dx)^2 + (py+t*dy)^2 = px*px + 2*px*dx*t + t^2*dx*dx + py*py + 2*py*dy*t + t^2*dy*dy
                     // derivative: 2*px*dx + 2*py*dy + (2*dx*dx+2*dy*dy)*t, set to 0 and solve
                     float t = -(px*dx + py*dy) / (dx*dx + dy*dy);
                     if (t >= 0.0f && t <= 1.0f)
                        min_dist = dist;
                  }
               } else if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vcurve) {
                  float x2 = verts[i-1].x *scale_x, y2 = verts[i-1].y *scale_y;
                  float x1 = verts[i  ].cx*scale_x, y1 = verts[i  ].cy*scale_y;
                  float box_x0 = STBTT_min(STBTT_min(x0,x1),x2);
                  float box_y0 = STBTT_min(STBTT_min(y0,y1),y2);
                  float box_x1 = STBTT_max(STBTT_max(x0,x1),x2);
                  float box_y1 = STBTT_max(STBTT_max(y0,y1),y2);
                  // coarse culling against bbox to avoid computing cubic unnecessarily
                  if (sx > box_x0-min_dist && sx < box_x1+min_dist && sy > box_y0-min_dist && sy < box_y1+min_dist) {
                     int num=0;
                     float ax = x1-x0, ay = y1-y0;
                     float bx = x0 - 2*x1 + x2, by = y0 - 2*y1 + y2;
                     float mx = x0 - sx, my = y0 - sy;
                     float res[3] = {0.f,0.f,0.f};
                     float px,py,t,it,dist2;
                     float a_inv = precompute[i];
                     if (a_inv == 0.0) { // if a_inv is 0, it's 2nd degree so use quadratic formula
                        float a = 3*(ax*bx + ay*by);
                        float b = 2*(ax*ax + ay*ay) + (mx*bx+my*by);
                        float c = mx*ax+my*ay;
                        if (a == 0.0) { // if a is 0, it's linear
                           if (b != 0.0) {
                              res[num++] = -c/b;
                           }
                        } else {
                           float discriminant = b*b - 4*a*c;
                           if (discriminant < 0)
                              num = 0;
                           else {
                              float root = (float) STBTT_sqrt(discriminant);
                              res[0] = (-b - root)/(2*a);
                              res[1] = (-b + root)/(2*a);
                              num = 2; // don't bother distinguishing 1-solution case, as code below will still work
                           }
                        }
                     } else {
                        float b = 3*(ax*bx + ay*by) * a_inv; // could precompute this as it doesn't depend on sample point
                        float c = (2*(ax*ax + ay*ay) + (mx*bx+my*by)) * a_inv;
                        float d = (mx*ax+my*ay) * a_inv;
                        num = stbtt__solve_cubic(b, c, d, res);
                     }
                     dist2 = (x0-sx)*(x0-sx) + (y0-sy)*(y0-sy);
                     if (dist2 < min_dist*min_dist)
                        min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);

                     if (num >= 1 && res[0] >= 0.0f && res[0] <= 1.0f) {
                        t = res[0], it = 1.0f - t;
                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                     if (num >= 2 && res[1] >= 0.0f && res[1] <= 1.0f) {
                        t = res[1], it = 1.0f - t;
                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                     if (num >= 3 && res[2] >= 0.0f && res[2] <= 1.0f) {
                        t = res[2], it = 1.0f - t;
                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                  }
               }
            }
            if (winding == 0)
               min_dist = -min_dist;  // if outside the shape, value is negative
            val = onedge_value + pixel_dist_scale * min_dist;
            if (val < 0)
               val = 0;
            else if (val > 255)
               val = 255;
            data[(y-iy0)*w+(x-ix0)] = (unsigned char) val;
         }
      }
      STBTT_free(precompute, info->userdata);
      STBTT_free(verts, info->userdata);
   }
   return data;
}

STBTT_DEF unsigned char * stbtt_GetCodepointSDF(const stbtt_fontinfo *info, float scale, int codepoint, int padding, unsigned char onedge_value, float pixel_dist_scale, int *width, int *height, int *xoff, int *yoff)
{
   return stbtt_GetGlyphSDF(info, scale, stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint), padding, onedge_value, pixel_dist_scale, width, height, xoff, yoff);
}

STBTT_DEF void stbtt_FreeSDF(unsigned char *bitmap, void *userdata)
{
   STBTT_free(bitmap, userdata);
}

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//
// font name matching -- recommended not to use this
//

// check if a utf8 string contains a prefix which is the utf16 string; if so return length of matching utf8 string
static stbtt_int32 stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(stbtt_uint8 *s1, stbtt_int32 len1, stbtt_uint8 *s2, stbtt_int32 len2)
{
   stbtt_int32 i=0;

   // convert utf16 to utf8 and compare the results while converting
   while (len2) {
      stbtt_uint16 ch = s2[0]*256 + s2[1];
      if (ch < 0x80) {
         if (i >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != ch) return -1;
      } else if (ch < 0x800) {
         if (i+1 >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xc0 + (ch >> 6)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + (ch & 0x3f)) return -1;
      } else if (ch >= 0xd800 && ch < 0xdc00) {
         stbtt_uint32 c;
         stbtt_uint16 ch2 = s2[2]*256 + s2[3];
         if (i+3 >= len1) return -1;
         c = ((ch - 0xd800) << 10) + (ch2 - 0xdc00) + 0x10000;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xf0 + (c >> 18)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >> 12) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >>  6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c      ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         s2 += 2; // plus another 2 below
         len2 -= 2;
      } else if (ch >= 0xdc00 && ch < 0xe000) {
         return -1;
      } else {
         if (i+2 >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xe0 + (ch >> 12)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch >> 6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch     ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
      }
      s2 += 2;
      len2 -= 2;
   }
   return i;
}

static int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal(char *s1, int len1, char *s2, int len2)
{
   return len1 == stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix((stbtt_uint8*) s1, len1, (stbtt_uint8*) s2, len2);
}

// returns results in whatever encoding you request... but note that 2-byte encodings
// will be BIG-ENDIAN... use stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian() to compare
STBTT_DEF const char *stbtt_GetFontNameString(const stbtt_fontinfo *font, int *length, int platformID, int encodingID, int languageID, int nameID)
{
   stbtt_int32 i,count,stringOffset;
   stbtt_uint8 *fc = font->data;
   stbtt_uint32 offset = font->fontstart;
   stbtt_uint32 nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return NULL;

   count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);
   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      if (platformID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0) && encodingID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2)
          && languageID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4) && nameID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6)) {
         *length = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
         return (const char *) (fc+stringOffset+ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10));
      }
   }
   return NULL;
}

static int stbtt__matchpair(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 nm, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 nlen, stbtt_int32 target_id, stbtt_int32 next_id)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   stbtt_int32 count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stbtt_int32 stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);

   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      stbtt_int32 id = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6);
      if (id == target_id) {
         // find the encoding
         stbtt_int32 platform = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0), encoding = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2), language = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4);

         // is this a Unicode encoding?
         if (platform == 0 || (platform == 3 && encoding == 1) || (platform == 3 && encoding == 10)) {
            stbtt_int32 slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
            stbtt_int32 off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10);

            // check if there's a prefix match
            stbtt_int32 matchlen = stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(name, nlen, fc+stringOffset+off,slen);
            if (matchlen >= 0) {
               // check for target_id+1 immediately following, with same encoding & language
               if (i+1 < count && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+6) == next_id && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12) == platform && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+2) == encoding && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+4) == language) {
                  slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+8);
                  off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+10);
                  if (slen == 0) {
                     if (matchlen == nlen)
                        return 1;
                  } else if (matchlen < nlen && name[matchlen] == ' ') {
                     ++matchlen;
                     if (stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char*) (name+matchlen), nlen-matchlen, (char*)(fc+stringOffset+off),slen))
                        return 1;
                  }
               } else {
                  // if nothing immediately following
                  if (matchlen == nlen)
                     return 1;
               }
            }
         }

         // @TODO handle other encodings
      }
   }
   return 0;
}

static int stbtt__matches(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 offset, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 nlen = (stbtt_int32) STBTT_strlen((char *) name);
   stbtt_uint32 nm,hd;
   if (!stbtt__isfont(fc+offset)) return 0;

   // check italics/bold/underline flags in macStyle...
   if (flags) {
      hd = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "head");
      if ((ttUSHORT(fc+hd+44) & 7) != (flags & 7)) return 0;
   }

   nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return 0;

   if (flags) {
      // if we checked the macStyle flags, then just check the family and ignore the subfamily
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   } else {
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, 17))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1,  2))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   }

   return 0;
}

static int stbtt_FindMatchingFont_internal(unsigned char *font_collection, char *name_utf8, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   for (i=0;;++i) {
      stbtt_int32 off = stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(font_collection, i);
      if (off < 0) return off;
      if (stbtt__matches((stbtt_uint8 *) font_collection, off, (stbtt_uint8*) name_utf8, flags))
         return off;
   }
}

#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
#pragma GCC diagnostic push
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wcast-qual"
#endif

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_BakeFontBitmap(const unsigned char *data, int offset,
                                float pixel_height, unsigned char *pixels, int pw, int ph,
                                int first_char, int num_chars, stbtt_bakedchar *chardata)
{
   return stbtt_BakeFontBitmap_internal((unsigned char *) data, offset, pixel_height, pixels, pw, ph, first_char, num_chars, chardata);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(const unsigned char *data, int index)
{
   return stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex_internal((unsigned char *) data, index);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts(const unsigned char *data)
{
   return stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts_internal((unsigned char *) data);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_InitFont(stbtt_fontinfo *info, const unsigned char *data, int offset)
{
   return stbtt_InitFont_internal(info, (unsigned char *) data, offset);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_FindMatchingFont(const unsigned char *fontdata, const char *name, int flags)
{
   return stbtt_FindMatchingFont_internal((unsigned char *) fontdata, (char *) name, flags);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian(const char *s1, int len1, const char *s2, int len2)
{
   return stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char *) s1, len1, (char *) s2, len2);
}

#pragma once
#include "Struct.h"

// 蛻､螳壼峙蠖｢
enum class ColliderShape { Sphere, Capsule };

class Collider {

public:
	// 蜊雁ｾ・ｒ蜿門ｾ・
	virtual float GetRadius() const { return radius_; }

	// 蜊雁ｾ・ｒ險ｭ螳・
	void SetRadius(float radius) { radius_ = radius; }

	/// <summary>
	/// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶・蜿門ｾ・
	/// </summary>
	virtual Vector3 GetWorldPosition() const = 0;

	/// <summary>
	/// 陦晉ｪ∝愛螳・
	/// </summary>
	virtual void OnCollision(Collider* other) = 0;

	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｱ樊ｧ(閾ｪ蛻・繧貞叙蠕・
	uint32_t GetCollisionAttribute() const { return collisionAttribute_; }
	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｱ樊ｧ(閾ｪ蛻・繧定ｨｭ螳・
	void SetCollisionAttribute(uint32_t attribute) { collisionAttribute_ = attribute; }
	// 陦晉ｪ√・繧ｹ繧ｯ(逶ｸ謇・繧貞叙蠕・
	uint32_t GetCollisionMask() const { return collisionMask_; }
	// 陦晉ｪ√・繧ｹ繧ｯ(逶ｸ謇・繧定ｨｭ螳・
	void SetCollisionMask(uint32_t mask) { collisionMask_ = mask; }

	void SetIsGard(bool flag) { isAttack_ = flag; }
	bool GetIsAttack() { return isAttack_; }

	// 蝗ｳ蠖｢繧ｻ繝・ヨ
	ColliderShape GetShape() const { return shape_; }
	void SetShape(ColliderShape shape) { shape_ = shape; }

	void SetCapsule(const Segment& seg, float r) {
		segment_ = seg;
		capsuleRadius_ = r;
	}
	const Segment& GetSegment() const { return segment_; }
	float GetCapsuleRadius() const { return capsuleRadius_; }

	float GetHitPower() const { return hitPower_; }
	void SetHitPower(float power) { hitPower_ = power; }

	uint32_t GetDamage() { return damage_; };
	void SetDamage(const uint32_t& damage) { damage_ = damage; }

private:
	// 陦晉ｪ∝濠蠕・
	float radius_ = 0.8f;

	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｱ樊ｧ
	uint32_t collisionAttribute_ = 0xffffffff;
	// 陦晉ｪ√・繧ｹ繧ｯ
	uint32_t collisionMask_ = 0xffffffff;

	bool isAttack_ = false;

	// 陦晉ｪ∝峙蠖｢
	ColliderShape shape_ = ColliderShape::Sphere;

	Segment segment_;
	float capsuleRadius_ = 0.0f;
	float hitPower_ = 1.0f;

	// 荳弱∴繧九ム繝｡繝ｼ繧ｸ
	uint32_t damage_;

};

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ髯｣蝟ｶ
const uint32_t kCollisionAttributePlayer = 1 << 0;
// 謨ｵ髯｣蝟ｶ
const uint32_t kCollisionAttributeEnemy = 1 << 1;
// 謨ｵ縺ｮ蠑ｾ髯｣蝟ｶ
const uint32_t kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet = 1 << 2;
// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ蠑ｾ髯｣蝟ｶ
const uint32_t kCollisionAttributePlayerBullet = 1 << 3;
// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ繝峨Ο繝ｼ繝ｳ髯｣蝟ｶ
const uint32_t kCollisionAttributePlayerDrone = 1 << 4;

// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\collision\CollisionManager.cpp

void CollisionManager::CheckAllCollisions(Player* player, Enemy* enemy, BulletManager* bulletManager) {

	// 陦晉ｪ√・繝阪・繧ｸ繝｣縺ｮ繝ｪ繧ｹ繝医ｒ繧ｯ繝ｪ繧｢
	colliders_.clear();

	// 繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼ繧偵Μ繧ｹ繝医↓逋ｻ骭ｲ
	SetColliders(player, enemy, bulletManager);
	
	// 繝ｪ繧ｹ繝亥・縺ｮ繝壹い縺ｮ邱丞ｽ薙◆繧・
	std::list<Collider*>::iterator itrA = colliders_.begin();
	for (; itrA != colliders_.end(); ++itrA) {

		// 繧､繝・Ξ繝ｼ繧ｿA縺九ｉ繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼA繧貞叙蠕・
		Collider* colliderA = *itrA;

		std::list<Collider*>::iterator itrB = itrA;
		itrB++;

		for (; itrB != colliders_.end(); ++itrB) {

			// 繧､繝・Ξ繝ｼ繧ｿB縺九ｉ繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼB繧貞叙蠕・
			Collider* colliderB = *itrB;

			// 繝壹い縺ｮ縺ゅ◆繧雁愛螳・
			CheckCollisionPair(colliderA, colliderB);
		}
	}
}

void CollisionManager::CheckCollisionPair(Collider* colliderA, Collider* colliderB) {

	bool hit = false;

	// --- Sphere ﾃ・Sphere ---
	if (colliderA->GetShape() == ColliderShape::Sphere && colliderB->GetShape() == ColliderShape::Sphere) {
		float dist = Length(colliderA->GetWorldPosition() - colliderB->GetWorldPosition());
		hit = dist < (colliderA->GetRadius() + colliderB->GetRadius());
	}

	// --- Capsule・・aser・・ﾃ・Sphere ---
	else if (colliderA->GetShape() == ColliderShape::Capsule && colliderB->GetShape() == ColliderShape::Sphere) {
		Sphere s{colliderB->GetWorldPosition(), colliderB->GetRadius()};
		hit = IsCollision(colliderA->GetSegment(), s, colliderA->GetCapsuleRadius());
	} else if (colliderB->GetShape() == ColliderShape::Capsule && colliderA->GetShape() == ColliderShape::Sphere) {
		Sphere s{colliderA->GetWorldPosition(), colliderA->GetRadius()};
		hit = IsCollision(colliderB->GetSegment(), s, colliderB->GetCapsuleRadius());
	}

	if (!hit) {
		return;
	}

	// 繝輔ぅ繝ｫ繧ｿ繝ｪ繝ｳ繧ｰ
	bool canA = (colliderA->GetCollisionMask() & colliderB->GetCollisionAttribute());
	bool canB = (colliderB->GetCollisionMask() & colliderA->GetCollisionAttribute());
	if (!(canA || canB))
		return;

	colliderA->OnCollision(colliderB);
	colliderB->OnCollision(colliderA);
}

void CollisionManager::SetColliders(Player* player, Enemy* enemy, BulletManager* bulletManager) {

	// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ繧堤匳骭ｲ
	colliders_.push_back(player);

	// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ繝峨Ο繝ｼ繝ｳ繧堤匳骭ｲ
	for (PlayerDrone* drone : player->GetDronePtrs()) {
		colliders_.push_back(drone);
	}

	// 謨ｵ繧堤匳骭ｲ
	colliders_.push_back(enemy);

	// 蠑ｾ繧堤匳骭ｲ
	for (Bullet* bullet : bulletManager->GetBulletPtrs()) {
		colliders_.push_back(bullet);
	}

	//for (ExpEnemy* enemy : enemyManager->GetEnemyPtrs()) {
	//	colliders_.push_back(enemy);
	//}
	
}

#pragma once
#include "Collider.h"
#include <list>

class Enemy;
class Player;
class PlayerDrone;
class BulletManager;
class EnemyManager;

class CollisionManager {

public:
	/// <summary>
	/// 陦晉ｪ∝愛螳壹→蠢懃ｭ・
	/// </summary>
	void CheckAllCollisions(Player* player, Enemy* enemy, BulletManager* bulletManager);

	/// <summary>
	/// 繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼ莠後▽縺ｮ陦晉ｪ∝愛螳壹→蠢懃ｭ・
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="colliderA">繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼA</param>
	/// <param name="colliderB">繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼB</param>
	void CheckCollisionPair(Collider* colliderA, Collider* colliderB);

	/// <summary>
	/// 繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼ繧定ｨｭ螳壹☆繧・
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="player"></param>
	/// <param name="enemy"></param>
	void SetColliders(Player* player, Enemy* enemy, BulletManager* bulletManager);

private:
	// 繧ｳ繝ｩ繧､繝繝ｼ繝ｪ繧ｹ繝・
	std::list<Collider*> colliders_;
};

static constexpr float kDeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;

Enemy::~Enemy() {}

void Enemy::Fire() {

	assert(player_);

	// 蠑ｾ縺ｮ騾溷ｺｦ
	const float kBulletSpeed = 0.35f;

	// 閾ｪ繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ繧貞叙蠕・
	Vector3 playerPos = player_->GetWorldPosition();
	// 謨ｵ繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ縺ｮ繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶ｒ蜿門ｾ・
	Vector3 enemyPos = GetWorldPosition();
	// 謨ｵ繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ縺九ｉ閾ｪ繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ縺ｸ縺ｮ繝吶け繝医Ν繧呈ｱゅａ繧・
	Vector3 direction = playerPos - enemyPos;
	// 繝吶け繝医Ν縺ｮ豁｣隕丞喧
	direction = Normalize(direction);
	// 繝吶け繝医Ν縺ｮ髟ｷ縺輔ｒ騾溘＆縺ｫ蜷医ｏ縺帙ｋ
	direction = kBulletSpeed * direction;

	// 閾ｪ讖溘→蜷後§菴咲ｽｮ縺ｪ繧臥匱蟆・＠縺ｪ縺・
	if (direction.x == 0.0f && direction.y == 0.0f && direction.z == 0.0f) {
		return;
	}

	AttackParam attackParam;
	attackParam.bulletSpeed = kBulletSpeed;
	attackParam.bulletCount = 1;
	attackParam.spreadAngleDeg = 0.0f;


	attackController_.Fire(
		worldTransform_.translate,
		direction,
		attackParam,
		BulletOwner::kEnemy
	);
}

void Enemy::ShotgunFire()
{
	assert(player_);

	// 逋ｺ蟆・ｽ咲ｽｮ
	Vector3 origin = GetWorldPosition();

	// 蝓ｺ貅匁婿蜷・
	Vector3 baseDir;
	baseDir = Normalize(player_->GetWorldPosition() - origin);

	// 謾ｻ謦・ヱ繝ｩ繝｡繝ｼ繧ｿ繧定ｨｭ螳・
	AttackParam param{};
	param.bulletSpeed = 0.4f;
	param.bulletCount = 2;
	param.spreadAngleDeg = 30.0f;
	param.randomSpread = true;

	param.reflect = false;
	param.penetrate = false;
	param.cooldown = 0.7f;
	param.damage = 10;

	// 逋ｺ蟆・
	attackController_.Fire(
		origin,
		baseDir,
		param,
		BulletOwner::kEnemy
	);
}

void Enemy::Initialize(Object3d* object, const Vector3& position, Stage* stage) {

	hpBarFill_ = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
	hpBarFill_->Initialize();
	hpBarFill_->GetScale().y = 1.2f;
	hpBarFill_->SetModel("playerHPBarGreenLong.obj");

	hpBarFillTransform_ = InitWorldTransform();
	hpBarFillTransform_.translate = position;
	hpBarFill_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	hpBarFill_->Update();


	hpBarBG_ = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
	hpBarBG_->Initialize();
	hpBarBG_->GetScale().y = 1.2f;

	hpBarBG_->SetModel("playerHPBarLong.obj");

	hpBarBGTransform_ = InitWorldTransform();
	hpBarBGTransform_.translate = position;
	hpBarBG_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	hpBarBG_->Update();

	object_ = object;
	worldTransform_ = InitWorldTransform();
	worldTransform_.translate = position;
	worldTransform_.scale = Vector3(2.0f, 2.0f, 2.0f);

	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｱ樊ｧ繧定ｨｭ螳・
	SetCollisionAttribute(kCollisionAttributeEnemy);
	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｯｾ雎｡繧偵・繝ｬ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｨ繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ蠑ｾ縺ｫ險ｭ螳・
	SetCollisionMask(kCollisionAttributePlayer | kCollisionAttributePlayerBullet | kCollisionAttributePlayerDrone);

	stage_ = stage;
	
	sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	sprite->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/bossHPGreen.png");
	sprite->SetPosition({ 20.0f, 210.0f });
	
	bossHpRed = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	bossHpRed->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/bossHPRed.png");
	bossHpRed->SetPosition({ 20.0f, 210.0f });

	bossHpFont = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	bossHpFont->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/BossHp.png");
	bossHpFont->SetPosition({ 20.0f, 160.0f });
	bossHpFont->SetSize({120.0f, 40.0f});

}

void Enemy::Update(float deltaTime) {

	UpdateHPBar();

	Move(deltaTime);

	if (!isDead_){
		if (HasLineOfSightToPlayer()) {
			fireTimer_ -= deltaTime;
			if (fireTimer_ <= 0.0f) {
				ShotgunFire();
				fireTimer_ = kFireTimerMax_;
			}
		} else {

			// 隕也ｷ壹′騾壹▲縺ｦ縺・↑縺・ｴ蜷医∝ｰ代＠縺･縺､繧ｿ繧､繝槭・繧貞屓蠕ｩ
			if (fireTimer_ < kFireTimerMax_) {
				fireTimer_ += deltaTime;
			}
		}
	}

	// X遘ｻ蜍・
	Vector3 pos = GetWorldPosition();
	pos.x += GetMove().x * (deltaTime * 60.0f);
	SetWorldPosition(pos);
	stage_->ResolveEnemyCollision(*this, X);

	// Y遘ｻ蜍・
	pos = GetWorldPosition();
	pos.y += GetMove().y * (deltaTime * 60.0f);
	SetWorldPosition(pos);
	stage_->ResolveEnemyCollision(*this, Y);

	object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	object_->Update();

	if (hp_ <= 0) {
		Die();
		hp_ = 0;
	}
	if (isExploding_) {
		UpdateParticles(deltaTime);
	}

	sprite->SetSize(Vector2(float(hp_), sprite->GetSize().y));
	sprite->Update();
	bossHpRed->Update();
	bossHpFont->Update();
}

void Enemy::Draw() {
	if (!isDead_) {
		object_->Draw();
	}

	for (auto& p : particles_) {
		p.object->Draw();
	}
}

void Enemy::ApproachToPlayer(Vector3& startPos, Vector3& targetPos) {

	// 閾ｪ繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ繧貞叙蠕・
	Vector3 playerPos = player_->GetWorldPosition();
	// 謨ｵ繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ縺ｮ繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶ｒ蜿門ｾ・
	Vector3 enemyPos = GetWorldPosition();

	startPos = enemyPos;
	targetPos = playerPos;
}

Vector3 Enemy::GetWorldPosition() const {
	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶ｒ蜈･繧後ｋ
	Vector3 worldPos;
	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝芽｡悟・縺ｮ蟷ｳ陦檎ｧｻ蜍墓・蛻・ｒ蜿門ｾ・繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓・
	worldPos.x = worldTransform_.translate.x;
	worldPos.y = worldTransform_.translate.y;
	worldPos.z = worldTransform_.translate.z;

	return worldPos;
}

void Enemy::OnCollision(Collider* other) {
	
	// 縺､縺ｿ縺ｨ繝舌げ髦ｲ豁｢
	if (other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributePlayer || other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributePlayerDrone) {
		Vector3 dir = worldTransform_.translate - other->GetWorldPosition();

		if (Length(dir) < 0.001f) return;

		dir = Normalize(dir);

		const float knockPower = 2.0f;

		velocity_ += dir * knockPower * other->GetHitPower();
	}
	// 繝繝｡繝ｼ繧ｸ蜃ｦ逅・
	if (other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributePlayerBullet) {

		hp_ -= other->GetDamage();
	}
}

void Enemy::AIStateMovePower() {
	switch (aiState_) {
	case AIState::Attack:
		attackPower = 1.0f;
		evadePower = 0.9f;
		wanderPower = 0.1f;
		break;

	case AIState::Wander:
		attackPower = 0.3f;
		evadePower = 1.2f;
		wanderPower = 0.5f;
		break;

	case AIState::Evade:
		attackPower = 0.1f;
		evadePower = 3.0f;
		wanderPower = 0.3f;
		break;
	}
}

void Enemy::Move(float deltaTime) {
	
	UpdateAIState();

	AIStateMovePower();

	Vector3 toPlayer = player_->GetWorldPosition() - GetWorldPosition();
	Vector3 attackVec = Normalize(toPlayer) * attackPower;
	wanderChangeTimer -= deltaTime;
	if (wanderChangeTimer <= 0.0f) {
		wanderVec = RandomDirection() * wanderPower;
		wanderChangeTimer = 3.0f;
	}

	evadeVec = EvadeBullets() * evadePower;
	dir_ = attackVec + evadeVec + wanderVec + WallAvoidByRay();

	if (Length(dir_) > 0.0001f) {
		dir_ = Normalize(dir_);
	} else {
		dir_ = { 0, 0, 0 };
	}

	dir_.z = 0.0f;

	// --- 5. 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ縺ｨ譁ｹ蜷代・繧ｯ繝医Ν ---
	Vector3 dir = Normalize(toPlayer);

	// --- 6. 蝗櫁ｻ｢隗貞ｺｦ繧堤ｮ怜・ ---
	if (Length(velocity_) > 0.001f) {
		float angle = atan2(dir.y, dir.x);
		worldTransform_.rotate.z = angle;
		object_->SetRotate(worldTransform_.rotate);
	}

	if (isWallFollowing_) {

		wallFollowTimer_ -= 1.0f / 60.0f;
		dir_ = wallFollowDir_;

		if (wallFollowTimer_ <= 0.0f) {
			isWallFollowing_ = false;
		}
	}

	// 1. 縺ｾ縺壽束謫ｦ繧帝←逕ｨ・磯溷ｺｦ繧貞ｰ代＠貂幄｡ｰ縺輔○繧具ｼ・
    // 菴輔ｂ蜈･蜉帙′縺ｪ縺・→縺阪√％繧後〒繧・▲縺上ｊ豁｢縺ｾ繧・
    velocity_ *= friction_ * (deltaTime * 60.0f);

    // 2. 蜈･蜉帶婿蜷托ｼ・ir_・峨↓蜷代°縺｣縺ｦ蜉騾溘ｒ縲悟刈邂励阪☆繧・
    // 逶ｮ讓咎溷ｺｦ縺ｨ縺ｮ蟾ｮ蛻・〒縺ｯ縺ｪ縺上∫ｴ皮ｲ九↓縲悟鴨縲阪→縺励※雜ｳ縺・
    if (Length(dir_) > 0.0001f) {
        // 蜉騾溷ｺｦ accel_ 繧偵◎縺ｮ縺ｾ縺ｾ雜ｳ縺・
        velocity_ += dir_ * accel_ * (deltaTime * 60.0f);
    }

    // 3. 譛蠕後↓譛螟ｧ騾溷ｺｦ蛻ｶ髯舌ｒ縺九￠繧・
    if (Length(velocity_) > maxSpeed_) {
        velocity_ = Normalize(velocity_) * maxSpeed_;
    }
}

Vector3 Enemy::RandomDirection() { return Rand(Vector3(-0.2f, -0.2f, 0.0f), Vector3(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.5f)); }

Vector3 Enemy::EvadeBullets() {
	Vector3 evade(0, 0, 0);

	for (Bullet* bullet : bulletManager_->GetBulletPtrs()) {

		// 謨ｵ縺ｮ蠑ｾ縺ｯ辟｡隕・
		if (bullet->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet) {
			continue;
		}

		Vector3 toBullet = bullet->GetWorldPosition() - GetWorldPosition();
		float dist = Length(toBullet);

		const float kEvadeRadius = 10.0f;
		if (dist < kEvadeRadius) {

			toBullet *= -1.0f;
			Vector3 dir = Normalize(toBullet);
			float power = (kEvadeRadius - dist) / kEvadeRadius;

			evade += dir * power * 0.2f;
		}
	}

	return evade;
}

void Enemy::UpdateAIState() {

	Vector3 toPlayer = player_->GetWorldPosition() - GetWorldPosition();
	float dist = Length(toPlayer);

	// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ蠑ｾ縺ｮ蜊ｱ髯ｺ蛻､螳・
	bool bulletDanger = false;
	for (Bullet* bullet : bulletManager_->GetBulletPtrs()) {
		
		// 謨ｵ縺ｮ蠑ｾ縺ｯ辟｡隕・
		if (bullet->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet) {
			continue;
		}

		float distB = Length(bullet->GetWorldPosition() - GetWorldPosition());
		if (distB < 8.0f) {
			bulletDanger = true;
			break;
		}
	}

	// 竭 蠑ｾ縺悟些髯ｺ 竊・Evade 蠑ｷ蛻ｶ
	if (bulletDanger) {
		aiState_ = AIState::Evade;
		return;
	}

	// 竭｡ 霍晞屬縺ｫ繧医ｋ蛻・ｊ譖ｿ縺・
	if (dist > 25.0f) {
		aiState_ = AIState::Wander; // 驕縺・竊・謗｢縺励↑縺後ｉ蠕伜ｾ・
	} else if (dist > 10.0f) {
		aiState_ = AIState::Attack; // 荳ｭ霍晞屬 竊・謾ｻ謦・↓霑代▼縺・
	} else {
		aiState_ = AIState::Evade; // 霑代☆縺弱ｋ 竊・騾・￡繧・
	}
}

AABB Enemy::GetAABB() {
	Vector3 worldPos = GetWorldPosition();

	AABB aabb;

	aabb.min = { worldPos.x - kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y - kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z - kWidth / 2.0f };
	aabb.max = { worldPos.x + kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y + kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z + kWidth / 2.0f };

	return aabb;
}

Segment Enemy::MakeForwardRay(float length) const {

	Segment seg;
	seg.origin = GetWorldPosition();

	Vector3 forward = dir_;
	if (Length(forward) < 0.001f) {
		forward = { 1, 0, 0 }; // 菫晞匱
	}

	forward = Normalize(forward);

	seg.diff = forward * length; // 邱壼・縺ｮ蟾ｮ蛻・

	return seg;
}

bool Enemy::IsBlockNearByRay() {

	const float kRayLength = 3.0f;

	Segment ray = MakeForwardRay(kRayLength);
	
	for (const auto& row : stage_->GetBlocks()) {
		for (const Block& block : row) {

			if (!block.isActive) {
				continue;
			}

			if (IsCollision(block.aabb, ray)) {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}

	return false;
}

Vector3 Enemy::WallAvoidByRay() {

	Vector3 avoid(0, 0, 0);

	if (Length(dir_) < 0.001f) {
		return avoid;
	}

	Vector3 forward = Normalize(dir_);

	if (IsBlockNearByRay() && !isWallFollowing_) {
		
		Vector3 left(-forward.y, forward.x, 0);
		Vector3 right(forward.y, -forward.x, 0);

		float leftScore = ScoreDir(left);
		float rightScore = ScoreDir(right);

		
		isWallFollowing_ = true;
		wallFollowTimer_ = 1.2f; // 縺薙・譎る俣縺ｯ螢∵ｲｿ縺・━蜈・
		wallFollowDir_ = (leftScore < rightScore) ? left : right;

		// 豁｣髱｢繝悶Ξ繝ｼ繧ｭ
		avoid += -forward * 1.5f;

		// 讓ｪ縺ｸ騾・′縺呻ｼ亥｣∵ｲｿ縺・ｧｻ蜍包ｼ・
		Vector3 side(-forward.y, forward.x, 0.0f);
		avoid += side * 1.0f;
	}

	return avoid;
}

float Enemy::ScoreDir(const Vector3& dir)
{
	Vector3 futurePos = GetWorldPosition() + dir * 3.0f;
	return Length(player_->GetWorldPosition() - futurePos);
}

Segment Enemy::MakeRayToPlayer() const {

	Segment seg;
	seg.origin = GetWorldPosition();

	Vector3 toPlayer = player_->GetWorldPosition() - seg.origin;
	seg.diff = toPlayer; // 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｾ縺ｧ

	return seg;
}

bool Enemy::HitPlayerByRay(const Segment& ray)
{

	Sphere playerSphere;
	playerSphere.center = player_->GetWorldPosition();
	playerSphere.radius = player_->GetRadius();

	return IsCollision(ray, playerSphere);
}

bool Enemy::HasLineOfSightToPlayer() {

	Segment ray = MakeRayToPlayer();

	float playerDist = Length(ray.diff);
	
	Sphere playerSphere;
	playerSphere.center = player_->GetWorldPosition();
	playerSphere.radius = player_->GetRadius();
	
	// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｫ蠖薙◆繧具ｼ・
	if (!IsCollision(ray, playerSphere)) {
		return false;
	}

	// 謇句燕縺ｫ螢√′縺ゅｋ・・
	for (const auto& row : stage_->GetBlocks()) {
		for (const Block& block : row) {

			if (!block.isActive) {
				continue;
			}

			if (IsCollision(block.aabb, ray)) {

				// 繝悶Ο繝・け荳ｭ蠢・∪縺ｧ縺ｮ霍晞屬縺ｧ邁｡譏灘愛螳・
				float blockDist =
					Length((block.aabb.max + block.aabb.min) / 2.0f - ray.origin);

				if (blockDist < playerDist) {
					return false; // 螢√↓驕ｮ繧峨ｌ縺ｦ縺・ｋ
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return true; // 隕也ｷ壹′騾壹▲縺ｦ縺・ｋ
}

void Enemy::Die()
{
	if (isDead_) return;

	isDead_ = true;
	isExploding_ = true;

	SpawnParticles();
	//bullets_.clear();

	radius_ = 0.0f;
}

bool Enemy::isFinished()
{
	if (isDead_ && !isExploding_) {
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

void Enemy::SpawnParticles()
{
	const int particleCount = 30;
	Vector3 center = object_->GetTranslate();

	for (int i = 0; i < particleCount; ++i) {

		EnemyParticle p{};

		p.object = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
		p.object->Initialize();
		p.object->SetModel("enemyParticle.obj");

		p.object->SetTranslate(center);

		// ----------------------
		// 繝ｩ繝ｳ繝繝譁ｹ蜷・竊・豁｣隕丞喧
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 dir = Rand(
			Vector3{ -1.0f, -1.0f, -1.0f },
			Vector3{ 1.0f,  1.0f,  1.0f }
		);
		dir = Normalize(dir);

		p.velocity = dir * Rand(3.0f, 6.0f);

		// 蝗櫁ｻ｢騾溷ｺｦ
		p.rotateSpeed = Rand(
			Vector3{ -6.0f, -6.0f, -6.0f },
			Vector3{ 6.0f,  6.0f,  6.0f }
		);

		// ----------------------
		// 蟇ｿ蜻ｽ & 騾乗・蠎ｦ
		// ----------------------
		p.timer = 0.0f;
		p.lifeTime = Rand(0.9f, 1.4f);     // 笘・蛟倶ｽ灘ｷｮ
		p.startAlpha = Rand(0.6f, 1.0f);   // 笘・蛻晄悄繧｢繝ｫ繝輔ぃ

		// Add繝悶Ξ繝ｳ繝画丐縺育畑・亥ｰ代＠譏弱ｋ繧・ｼ・
		Vector4 color = {
			Rand(0.8f, 1.2f),
			Rand(0.8f, 1.2f),
			Rand(0.8f, 1.2f),
			p.startAlpha
		};
		p.object->SetColor(color);

		particles_.push_back(std::move(p));
	}
}

void Enemy::UpdateParticles(float deltaTime)
{
	for (auto& p : particles_) {

		p.timer += deltaTime;
		if (p.timer >= p.lifeTime) continue;

		float t = p.timer / p.lifeTime; // 0.0 竊・1.0

		// ----------------------
		// 遘ｻ蜍・
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 pos = p.object->GetTranslate();
		pos += p.velocity * deltaTime;

		// 貂幃・
		p.velocity *= 0.97f;

		// 驥榊鴨
		p.velocity.y -= 6.0f * deltaTime;

		// ----------------------
		// 蝗櫁ｻ｢
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 rot = p.object->GetRotate();
		rot += p.rotateSpeed * deltaTime;

		// ----------------------
		// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨い繧ｦ繝・
		// ----------------------
		float alpha = p.startAlpha * (1.0f - t);
		alpha = std::max(alpha, 0.0f);

		Vector4 color = p.object->GetColor();
		color.w = alpha;
		p.object->SetColor(color);

		// ----------------------
		p.object->SetTranslate(pos);
		p.object->SetRotate(rot);
		p.object->Update();
	}

	// 蟇ｿ蜻ｽ蛻・ｌ蜑企勁
	particles_.erase(
		std::remove_if(
			particles_.begin(),
			particles_.end(),
			[](const EnemyParticle& p) {
				return p.timer >= p.lifeTime;
			}),
		particles_.end()
	);

	if (particles_.empty()) {
		isExploding_ = false;
	}
}

void Enemy::UpdateHPBar()
{
	Vector3 enemyPos = GetWorldPosition();
	Vector3 barOffset = { -2.0f, -2.5f, 0.0f }; // 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ蟆代＠荳九↓驟咲ｽｮ

	// 閭梧勹縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ
	hpBarBGTransform_.translate = enemyPos + barOffset;
	hpBarBG_->SetTransform(hpBarBGTransform_);
	hpBarBG_->Update();

	// 繧ｲ繝ｼ繧ｸ荳ｭ霄ｫ縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ
	float hpPercent = (float)hp_ / (float)maxHP_;
	hpBarFillTransform_.translate = enemyPos + barOffset;
	// X繧ｹ繧ｱ繝ｼ繝ｫ縺縺践P蜑ｲ蜷医↓縺吶ｋ
	hpBarFillTransform_.scale.x = 1.0f * hpPercent;

	// 繧ｲ繝ｼ繧ｸ縺悟ｷｦ遶ｯ縺九ｉ邵ｮ繧繧医≧縺ｫ縲∝ｰ代＠菴咲ｽｮ繧偵★繧峨☆隱ｿ謨ｴ繧偵☆繧九→繧医ｊ邯ｺ鮗励〒縺・
	//hpBarFillTransform_.translate.x -= 3.0f * (1.0f - hpPercent) * 0.5f;

	hpBarFill_->SetTransform(hpBarFillTransform_);
	hpBarFill_->Update();

}

void Enemy::HPBarDraw()
{
	if (!isDead_) {
		hpBarBG_->Draw();
		hpBarFill_->Draw();
	}
}

#include "ApproachState.h"
#include "LeaveState.h"
using namespace KamataEngine;
using namespace MathUtility;

void ApproachState::Initialize(Enemy& enemy) {
	time_ = 0.0f;
	enemy.ApproachToPlayer(startPos_, targetPos_);
}

void ApproachState::Update(Enemy& enemy) {

	Vector3 pos;
	float distance;
	Vector3 direction;
	float speed;

	switch (phase_) {
	case ApproachState::Phase::kStart:

		// 縲莠亥ｙ蜍穂ｽ・
		time_ += 1.0f / 60.0f;
		if (time_ >= 0.3f) {
			time_ = 0.0f;
			phase_ = Phase::kAttack;
		}

		break;
	case ApproachState::Phase::kAttack:

		// 迴ｾ蝨ｨ菴咲ｽｮ
		pos = enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_;

		// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ譁ｹ蜷代ｒ蜿門ｾ暦ｼ・argetPos_ 縺ｯ繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ・・
		direction = targetPos_ - pos;

		// 霍晞屬繧貞叙蠕・
		distance = Length(direction);

		// 邨ゆｺ・愛螳夲ｼ井ｸ螳夊ｷ晞屬莉･荳九↓縺ｪ縺｣縺溘ｉ邨ゆｺ・ｼ・
		if (distance < 1.0f) {
			phase_ = Phase::kEnd;
			time_ = 0.0f;
			break;
		}

		// 豁｣隕丞喧・域婿蜷代□縺代↓縺吶ｋ・・
		direction = Normalize(direction);

		// 蝗ｺ螳夐溷ｺｦ
		speed = 0.5f; // 隱ｿ謨ｴ蜿ｯ閭ｽ・・□縺上※繧ょ酔縺倬溷ｺｦ

		// 遘ｻ蜍・
		pos = pos + direction * speed;

		enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_ = pos;

		//// 謨ｵ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ繧定｣懷ｮ・
		// enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_ = {
		//     startPos_.x + (targetPos_.x - startPos_.x) * (time_ / duration_),
		//     startPos_.y + (targetPos_.y - startPos_.y) * (time_ / duration_),
		//     startPos_.z + (targetPos_.z - startPos_.z) * (time_ / duration_),
		// };

		// time_ += 1.0f / 60.0f;
		// if (time_ >= duration_) {
		//	time_ = 0.0f;
		//	phase_ = Phase::kEnd;
		// }

		break;
	case ApproachState::Phase::kEnd:
		time_ += 1.0f / 60.0f;
		if (time_ >= 0.3f) {
			time_ = 0.0f;
			enemy.StateChange();
		}

		break;
	default:
		break;
	}
}

#pragma once
class Enemy;

class BaseEnemyState {
public:
	virtual ~BaseEnemyState() = default;
	// 迥ｶ諷九＃縺ｨ縺ｮ蛻晄悄蛹・
	virtual void Initialize(Enemy& enemy) = 0;
	// 迥ｶ諷九＃縺ｨ縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ蜃ｦ逅・
	virtual void Update(Enemy& enemy) = 0;
};

// ==================================================
// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\enemy\state\FallState.cpp
// ==================================================

#include "FallState.h"
#include "SniperState.h"
#include "WaveState.h"

void FallState::Initialize(Enemy& enemy) { (void)enemy; }

void FallState::Update(Enemy& enemy) {

	switch (fallPhase_) {
	case FallState::FallPhase::kStart:

		// 莠亥ｙ蜍穂ｽ懊〒髴・∴繧・

		enemy.IsShaking() = true;
		time_--;
		if (time_ <= 0) {
			time_ = 60;
			fallPhase_ = FallPhase::kFalling;
			enemy.IsShaking() = false;
		}

		break;
	case FallState::FallPhase::kFalling:

		fallSpeed_ += fallAcceleration_;
		enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y -= fallSpeed_;
		if (enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y < 2.0f) {
			enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y = 2.0f;
			fallPhase_ = FallPhase::kRockfalling;
			enemy.Avalanche();
		}

		break;
	case FallState::FallPhase::kRockfalling:

		time_--;
		if (time_ <= 0) {
			time_ = 60;
			fallPhase_ = FallPhase::kEnd;
		}

		break;
	case FallState::FallPhase::kEnd:
		enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y += 0.1f;
		if (enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y > 5.0f) {

			enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y = 5.0f;
			fallPhase_ = FallPhase::kStart;

			// enemy.SetState(std::make_unique<SniperState>());
			// enemy.Fire(true);
			enemy.StateChange();
		}
		break;
	default:
		break;
	}
}

#pragma once
#include "BaseEnemyState.h"
#include "Enemy.h"

class FallState : public BaseEnemyState {
public:
	void Initialize(Enemy& enemy) override;

	void Update(Enemy& enemy) override;

private:
	enum class FallPhase {
		kStart,       // 髢句ｧ・
		kFalling,     // 關ｽ荳倶ｸｭ
		kRockfalling, // 縺後ｌ縺・
		kEnd,         // 邨ゆｺ・
	};

	FallPhase fallPhase_ = FallPhase::kStart;

	uint32_t time_ = 60;
	float fallAcceleration_ = 0.01f;
	float fallSpeed_ = 0.0f;
};

#include "SniperState.h"

void SniperState::Initialize(Enemy& enemy) { (void)enemy; }

void SniperState::Update(Enemy& enemy) {

	time_--;
	if (time_ % 15 == 0) {
		enemy.ShotgunFire(1, 75.0f, false);
	}

	if (time_ <= 0) {
		time_ = 60;
		enemy.StateChange();
	}
}

#include "TimeCall.h"
using namespace KamataEngine;

// 繝｡繝ｳ繝仙・譛溷喧蟄舌〒蛻晄悄蛹・
TimeCall::TimeCall(std::function<void(void)> func, uint32_t time) : func_(std::move(func)), time_(time) {}

void TimeCall::Update() {

	if (isFinished_) {
		return;
	}

	time_--;
	if (time_ <= 0) {

		isFinished_ = true;
		// 繧ｳ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝舌ャ繧ｯ繧貞他縺ｳ蜃ｺ縺・
		func_();
	}
}

#pragma once

#include <functional>

class TimeCall {

public:
	// 繧ｳ繝ｳ繧ｹ繝医Λ繧ｯ繧ｿ
	TimeCall(std::function<void(void)> func, uint32_t time);

	// 譖ｴ譁ｰ
	void Update();

	// 螳御ｺ・↑繧液rue繧定ｿ斐☆
	bool IsFinished() { return isFinished_; }

private:
	// 繧ｳ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝舌ャ繧ｯ
	std::function<void(void)> func_;
	// 谿九ｊ譎る俣
	uint32_t time_;
	// 螳御ｺ・ヵ繝ｩ繧ｰ
	bool isFinished_ = false;
};

#include "WaveState.h"

void WaveState::Initialize(Enemy& enemy) { (void)enemy; }

void WaveState::Update(Enemy& enemy) {
	// 荳贋ｸ九↓蜍輔￥
	time_ += 0.5f;

	if (int(time_ * 2) % 60 == 0) {
		enemy.Fire(true);
	}

	const float waveAmplitude = 0.1f;  // 謖ｯ蟷・
	const float waveFrequency = 0.05f; // 蜻ｨ豕｢謨ｰ

	float t = time_;

	enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y = enemy.GetWorldPosition().y + std::cos(t * waveFrequency) * waveAmplitude;

	if (enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y > 15.0f) {
		enemy.GetWorldTransform().translation_.y = 15.0f;
	}

	if (time_ >= 180.0f) {
		enemy.StateChange();
	}
}

#include "EnemyManager.h"
#include "Stage.h"
#include "Player.h"
#include "Calculation.h"

void EnemyManager::Initialize(Player* player, BulletManager* bulletManager) {
    player_ = player;
    bulletManager_ = bulletManager;
}

void EnemyManager::Update(Stage& stage, float deltaTime) {
    // 1. 荳螳夐俣髫斐〒繧ｹ繝昴・繝ｳ
    spawnTimer_ -= deltaTime;
    if (spawnTimer_ <= 0.0f && enemies_.size() < kMaxEnemies) {
        Spawn(stage);
        spawnTimer_ = kSpawnInterval;
    }

    // 2. 蜈ｨ縺ｦ縺ｮ謨ｵ繧呈峩譁ｰ & 繝・せ繝輔Λ繧ｰ縺檎ｫ九▲縺溘ｉ蜑企勁
    for (auto it = enemies_.begin(); it != enemies_.end(); ) {
        (*it)->Update(stage, deltaTime);

        if ((*it)->IsDead()) {
            it = enemies_.erase(it); // 蜑企勁
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
}

void EnemyManager::Spawn(Stage& stage) {
    // 繧ｹ繝・・繧ｸ縺ｮ遽・峇・井ｻｮ縺ｫ0~30縺ｨ縺吶ｋ縲ゅ♀謇句・縺ｮmap繧ｵ繧､繧ｺ縺ｫ蜷医ｏ縺帙※隱ｿ謨ｴ縺励※縺上□縺輔＞・・
    const float kMapMin = 2.0f;
    const float kMapMax = 28.0f;

    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) { // 譛螟ｧ10蝗槭Μ繝医Λ繧､
        Vector3 spawnPos = { Rand(kMapMin, kMapMax), Rand(kMapMin, kMapMax), 0.0f };

        // 螢√→驥阪↑縺｣縺ｦ縺・↑縺・°遒ｺ隱・
        if (!stage.IsCollisionWithAnyBlock(spawnPos, 1.0f)) {
            // 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ縺吶＄霑代￥縺ｫ縺ｯ蜃ｺ縺輔↑縺・ｼ亥ｮ牙・縺ｮ縺溘ａ・・
            float dist = Length(spawnPos - player_->GetWorldPosition());
            if (dist < 10.0f) continue;

            // 逕滓・
            auto newEnemy = std::make_unique<ExpEnemy>();
            newEnemy->Initialize(spawnPos, player_);
            newEnemy->SetAttackControllerBulletManager(bulletManager_);
            // AttackController縺悟ｿ・ｦ√↑蝣ｴ蜷医・縺薙％縺ｧ繧ｻ繝・ヨ繧｢繝・・
            enemies_.push_back(std::move(newEnemy));
            break;
        }
    }
}

void EnemyManager::Draw() {
    for (auto& enemy : enemies_) {
        enemy->Draw();
    }
}

std::vector<ExpEnemy*> EnemyManager::GetEnemyPtrs() const {
    std::vector<ExpEnemy*> result;
    result.reserve(enemies_.size());
    for (const auto& e : enemies_) {
        result.push_back(e.get());
    }
    return result;
}

#pragma once
#include <list>
#include <memory>
#include "ExpEnemy.h"

class Player;
class Stage;
class BulletManager;

class EnemyManager {
public:
    void Initialize(Player* player, BulletManager* bulletManager);
    void Update(Stage& stage, float deltaTime);
    void Draw();

    // 陦晉ｪ∝愛螳壹・縺溘ａ縺ｫ繝ｪ繧ｹ繝医ｒ蜈ｬ髢・
    std::vector<ExpEnemy*> GetEnemyPtrs() const;

private:
    void Spawn(Stage& stage);

    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ExpEnemy>> enemies_;
    Player* player_ = nullptr;
    BulletManager* bulletManager_ = nullptr;

    float spawnTimer_ = 0.0f;
    const float kSpawnInterval = 1.5f; // 1.5遘偵↓1蝗樒函謌占ｩｦ陦・
    const int kMaxEnemies = 30;        // 譛螟ｧ謨ｰ
};

#include "ExpEnemy.h"
#include "Player.h"
#include "Stage.h"

void ExpEnemy::Initialize(const Vector3& position, Player* player)
{
    object_ = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
    object_->Initialize();

    worldTransform_ = InitWorldTransform();
    worldTransform_.translate = position;
    worldTransform_.scale = Vector3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);

    object_->SetModel("enemyParticle.obj");

    // 陦晉ｪ∝ｱ樊ｧ繧定ｨｭ螳・
    SetCollisionAttribute(kCollisionAttributeEnemy);
    // 陦晉ｪ∝ｯｾ雎｡繧偵・繝ｬ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｨ繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ蠑ｾ縺ｫ險ｭ螳・
    SetCollisionMask(kCollisionAttributePlayer | kCollisionAttributePlayerBullet | kCollisionAttributePlayerDrone);

    player_ = player;

    object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
    object_->Update();

}

void ExpEnemy::Update(Stage& stage, float deltaTime) {

    // 蠎ｧ讓吶ｒ遘ｻ蜍輔＆縺帙ｋ
    //worldTransform_.translate += velocity_ * (deltaTime * 60.0f);

    dt_ = deltaTime;

    invincibleTimer_ -= deltaTime;

    // --- 諷｣諤ｧ蜃ｦ逅・---
    velocity_ += (velocity_ * -1.0f) * 0.98f * deltaTime;

    float timeWeight = deltaTime * 60.0f;

    // X遘ｻ蜍・
    Vector3 pos = GetWorldPosition();
    pos.x += velocity_.x * timeWeight;
    SetWorldPosition(pos);
    stage.ResolveExpEnemyCollision(*this, X);

    // Y遘ｻ蜍・
    pos = GetWorldPosition();
    pos.y += velocity_.y * timeWeight;
    SetWorldPosition(pos);
    stage.ResolveExpEnemyCollision(*this, Y);

    // 1. 縺昴・蝣ｴ縺ｧ蝗櫁ｻ｢縺輔○繧具ｼ郁ｦ九◆逶ｮ縺ｮ蜍輔″・・
    worldTransform_.rotate.y += 0.2f * deltaTime;
    worldTransform_.rotate.x += 0.2f * deltaTime;
    worldTransform_.rotate.z += 0.2f * deltaTime;
    object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
    object_->Update();

    // 2. 荳螳夐俣髫斐〒蠑ｾ繧呈茶縺､・亥渚謦・ぐ繝溘ャ繧ｯ・・
    bulletCoolTime -= deltaTime;
    if (bulletCoolTime <= 0.0f) { // 2遘偵↓1蝗・

        // 逋ｺ蟆・ｽ咲ｽｮ
        Vector3 origin = GetWorldPosition();

        // 蝓ｺ貅匁婿蜷・
        Vector3 baseDir;
        baseDir = Normalize(player_->GetWorldPosition() - origin);
        
        // 謾ｻ謦・ヱ繝ｩ繝｡繝ｼ繧ｿ繧定ｨｭ螳・
        AttackParam param{};
        param.bulletSpeed = 0.2f;
        param.bulletCount = 1;
        param.spreadAngleDeg = 5.0f;
        param.randomSpread = true;

        param.reflect = false;
        param.penetrate = false;
        param.cooldown = 1.0f;
        param.damage = 1;

        attackController_.Fire(origin, baseDir, param, BulletOwner::kEnemy);

        bulletCoolTime = 2.0f;
    }
}

void ExpEnemy::Draw() {
    object_->Draw();
}

void ExpEnemy::OnCollision(Collider* other)
{
    Vector3 hitDir =
        worldTransform_.translate - other->GetWorldPosition();

    hitDir = Normalize(hitDir);

    const float kKnockBackPower = 0.05f;

    velocity_ += hitDir * kKnockBackPower * other->GetHitPower() * (dt_ * 60.0f);
    
    if (other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributePlayer && invincibleTimer_ > 0.0f) {
        return;
    }

    hp_ -= other->GetDamage();
    if (hp_ <= 0) {
        isDead_ = true;
        player_->AddExp(expValue_);
    }

    if (other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributePlayer) {
        invincibleTimer_ = 0.5f;
    }
}

AABB ExpEnemy::GetAABB() {
    Vector3 worldPos = GetWorldPosition();

    AABB aabb;

    aabb.min = { worldPos.x - kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y - kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z - kWidth / 2.0f };
    aabb.max = { worldPos.x + kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y + kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z + kWidth / 2.0f };

    return aabb;
}

#pragma once
#include "Collider.h"
#include "Object3d.h"
#include "AttackController.h"

class Player;
class Stage;

class ExpEnemy : public Collider {
public:
    void Initialize(const Vector3& position, Player* player);
    void Update(Stage& stage,float deltaTime);
    void Draw();

    void OnCollision(Collider* other) override;

    // Collider蠢・磯未謨ｰ
    Vector3 GetWorldPosition() const override { return worldTransform_.translate; }
    float GetRadius() const override { return 0.8f; } // 隕九◆逶ｮ縺ｯ蟆代＠螟ｧ縺阪￥縺ｦ繧ょ愛螳壹・縺薙・縺上ｉ縺・

    void SetAttackControllerBulletManager(BulletManager* bulletManager) {
        attackController_.SetBulletManager(bulletManager);
    }

    // 繧ｻ繝・ち繝ｼ
    void SetWorldPosition(const Vector3& pos) {
        worldTransform_.translate = pos;
        object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
        object_->Update();
    }

    AABB GetAABB();

    bool IsDead() const { return isDead_; }

    uint32_t GetExpValue() const { return expValue_; }

private:
    Transform worldTransform_;
    std::unique_ptr<Object3d> object_;

    // 謾ｻ謦・さ繝ｳ繝医Ο繝ｼ繝ｩ
    AttackController attackController_;

    Player* player_ = nullptr;

    int hp_ = 10;
    float bulletCoolTime = 0.0f;

    // 繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ繧ｯ繧ｿ繝ｼ縺ｮ蠖薙◆繧雁愛螳壹し繧､繧ｺ
    static inline const float kWidth = 1.6f;
    static inline const float kHeight = 1.6f;

    bool isDead_ = false;

    uint32_t expValue_ = 10;

    Vector3 velocity_;

    float decel_ = 3.5f; // 貂幃滂ｼ医ヶ繝ｬ繝ｼ繧ｭ・・

    // 繝・Ν繧ｿ繧ｿ繧､繝
    float dt_ = 1.0f / 60.0f;

    // 辟｡謨ｵ譎る俣
    float invincibleTimer_ = 0.0f;

};

// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\mapchip\MapChip.cpp

#include "MapChip.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <sstream>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace {

std::unordered_map<std::string, MapChipType> mapChipTable = {
    {"0", MapChipType::kBlank},
    {"1", MapChipType::kBlock},
	{"2", MapChipType::kDamageBlock},
};
}

void MapChip::ResetMapChipData() {

	// 繝槭ャ繝励メ繝・・繝・・繧ｿ繧偵Μ繧ｻ繝・ヨ
	mapChipData_.data.clear();
	mapChipData_.data.resize(kNumBlockVirtical);
	for (std::vector<MapChipType>& mapChipDataLine : mapChipData_.data) {
		mapChipDataLine.resize(kNumBlockHorizontal);
	}
}

void MapChip::LoadMapChipCsv(const std::string& filePath) {

	// 繝槭ャ繝励メ繝・・繝・・繧ｿ繧偵Μ繧ｻ繝・ヨ
	ResetMapChipData();

	// 繝輔ぃ繧､繝ｫ繧帝幕縺・
	std::ifstream file;
	file.open(filePath);
	assert(file.is_open());

	// 繝槭ャ繝励メ繝・・CSV
	std::stringstream mapChipCsv;
	// 繝輔ぃ繧､繝ｫ縺ｮ蜀・ｮｹ繧呈枚蟄怜・繧ｹ繝医Μ繝ｼ繝縺ｫ繧ｳ繝斐・
	mapChipCsv << file.rdbuf();
	// 繝輔ぃ繧､繝ｫ繧帝哩縺倥ｋ
	file.close();

	// CSV縺九ｉ繝槭ャ繝励メ繝・・繝・・繧ｿ繧定ｪｭ縺ｿ霎ｼ繧
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < kNumBlockVirtical; ++i) {
		std::string line;
		getline(mapChipCsv, line);

		// i陦悟・縺ｮ譁・ｭ怜・繧偵せ繝医Μ繝ｼ繝縺ｫ螟画鋤縺励※隗｣譫舌＠繧・☆縺上☆繧・
		std::istringstream line_stream(line);

		for (uint32_t j = 0; j < kNumBlockHorizontal; ++j) {

			std::string word;
			getline(line_stream, word, ',');

			if (mapChipTable.contains(word)) {
				mapChipData_.data[i][j] = mapChipTable[word];
			}
		}
	}
}

MapChipType MapChip::GetMapChipTypeByIndex(uint32_t xIndex, uint32_t yIndex) {

	if (xIndex < 0 || kNumBlockHorizontal - 1 < xIndex) {
		return MapChipType::kBlank;
	}
	if (yIndex < 0 || kNumBlockVirtical - 1 < yIndex) {
		return MapChipType::kBlank;
	}

	return mapChipData_.data[yIndex][xIndex];
}

Vector3 MapChip::GetMapChipPositionByIndex(uint32_t xIndex, uint32_t yIndex) { return Vector3(kBlockWidth * xIndex, kBlockHeight * (kNumBlockVirtical - 1 - yIndex), 0); }

#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <vector>
#include "Struct.h"

enum class MapChipType {
	kBlank,  // 遨ｺ逋ｽ
	kBlock,  // 繝悶Ο繝・け
	kDamageBlock, // 繝繝｡繝ｼ繧ｸ繝悶Ο繝・け
};

// ==================================================
// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\player\actor\AttackController.cpp
// ==================================================

#include "AttackController.h"
#include <DirectXMath.h>
using namespace DirectX;

void AttackController::Fire(const Vector3& origin, const Vector3& baseDir, const AttackParam& param, BulletOwner owner)
{

    assert(bulletManager_);
    Vector3 dirNorm = Normalize(baseDir);

    float halfSpread = param.spreadAngleDeg * 0.5f;

    for (int i = 0; i < param.bulletCount; ++i) {

        float angleOffset;
        if (param.randomSpread) {
            angleOffset = Rand(-halfSpread, halfSpread);
        } else {
            angleOffset = (param.bulletCount <= 1)
                ? 0.0f
                : -halfSpread +
                (param.spreadAngleDeg / (param.bulletCount - 1)) * i;
        }

        float rad = XMConvertToRadians(angleOffset);

        Vector3 dirRotated;
        dirRotated.x = dirNorm.x * cosf(rad) - dirNorm.y * sinf(rad);
        dirRotated.y = dirNorm.x * sinf(rad) + dirNorm.y * cosf(rad);
        dirRotated.z = dirNorm.z;

        Vector3 velocity = param.bulletSpeed * dirRotated;

        auto bullet = std::make_unique<Bullet>();
        
        // 謨ｵ縺ｨ繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｧ逋ｺ蟆・ｽ咲ｽｮ繧貞ｰ代＠螟峨∴繧・
        Vector3 bulletOrigin;
        if (owner == BulletOwner::kPlayer) {
            bulletOrigin = origin + (baseDir * 1.5f);
        } else if (owner == BulletOwner::kEnemy) {
            bulletOrigin = origin + (baseDir * 3.0f);
        }
        
        bullet->Initialize(
            bulletOrigin,
            velocity,
            param.damage,
            owner,
            param.reflect
        );

        bulletManager_->Add(std::move(bullet));
    }
}

#include "Bullet.h"

void Bullet::Initialize(const Vector3& position, const Vector3& velocity, const uint32_t& damage, BulletOwner owner,
	bool reflectable) {
	object_ = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
	object_->Initialize();

	owner_ = owner;
	isReflectable_ = reflectable;
	

	// 繝｢繝・Ν蛻・ｊ譖ｿ縺茨ｼ郁ｦ九◆逶ｮ蟾ｮ蛻・ｼ・
	if (owner_ == kPlayer) {
		object_->SetModel("playerBullet.obj");
		SetCollisionAttribute(kCollisionAttributePlayerBullet);
		SetCollisionMask(kCollisionAttributeEnemy);
		if (isReflectable_) {
			object_->SetColor(Vector4(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
		}
	} else if (owner_ == kEnemy) {
		object_->SetModel("enemyBullet.obj");
		SetCollisionAttribute(kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet);
		SetCollisionMask(kCollisionAttributePlayer | kCollisionAttributePlayerDrone);
	}

	worldTransform_ = InitWorldTransform();
	worldTransform_.translate = position;
	worldTransform_.scale = Vector3(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
	velocity_ = velocity;

	SetDamage(damage);

	object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	object_->Update();
}

void Bullet::Update(float deltaTime) {

	// 蠎ｧ讓吶ｒ遘ｻ蜍輔＆縺帙ｋ
	worldTransform_.translate += velocity_ * (deltaTime * 60.0f);

	// 譎る俣邨碁℃縺ｧ繝・せ
	deathTimer_ -= deltaTime;
	if (deathTimer_ <= 0) {
		isDead_ = true;
	}

	object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	object_->Update();

}

void Bullet::Draw() {

	object_->Draw();

}

void Bullet::OnCollision(Collider* other) {
	(void)other;
	// 繝・せ繝輔Λ繧ｰ繧堤ｫ九※繧・
	isDead_ = true;
}

Vector3 Bullet::GetWorldPosition() const {

	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶ｒ蜈･繧後ｋ螟画焚
	Vector3 worldPos;
	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝芽｡悟・縺ｮ蟷ｳ陦檎ｧｻ蜍墓・蛻・ｒ蜿門ｾ・繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓・
	worldPos.x = worldTransform_.translate.x;
	worldPos.y = worldTransform_.translate.y;
	worldPos.z = worldTransform_.translate.z;

	return worldPos;
}

void Bullet::Die() {
	isDead_ = true;
}

#pragma once

class Bullet : public Collider {

public:

	void Initialize(const Vector3& position, const Vector3& velocity, const uint32_t& damage, BulletOwner owner,
		bool reflectable);

	void Update(float deltaTime);

	void Draw();

	bool IsDead() const { return isDead_; }

	/// <summary>
	/// 陦晉ｪ∝愛螳・
	/// </summary>
	void OnCollision(Collider* other) override;

	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶ｒ蜿門ｾ・
	Vector3 GetWorldPosition() const override;

	Vector3 GetMove() { return velocity_; }

	// 繧ｻ繝・ち繝ｼ
	void SetWorldPosition(const Vector3& pos) {
		worldTransform_.translate = pos;
		object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
		object_->Update();
	}

	void SetVelocity(const Vector3& v) { velocity_ = v; }

	float GetRadius() const override { return radius_; }

	bool IsReflectable() const { return isReflectable_; }

	void Die();

private:

	std::unique_ptr<Object3d> object_;

	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝峨ヨ繝ｩ繝ｳ繧ｹ繝輔か繝ｼ繝
	Transform worldTransform_;

	// 騾溷ｺｦ
	Vector3 velocity_;

	// 蟇ｿ蜻ｽ
	const float kLifeTime = 3.0f;
	// 繝・せ繧ｿ繧､繝槭・
	float deathTimer_ = kLifeTime;
	// 繝・せ繝輔Λ繧ｰ
	bool isDead_ = false;

	// 繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ繧ｯ繧ｿ繝ｼ縺ｮ蠖薙◆繧雁愛螳壹し繧､繧ｺ
	static inline const float kWidth = 1.6f;
	static inline const float kHeight = 1.6f;

	float radius_ = 0.5f;

	// 蜿榊ｰ・☆繧九°
	bool isReflectable_ = false;
	BulletOwner owner_;
};

#include "BulletManager.h"
#include "Bullet.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include "Stage.h"

void BulletManager::Add(std::unique_ptr<Bullet> bullet) {
    bullets_.push_back(std::move(bullet));
}

void BulletManager::Update(Stage& stage, float deltaTime) {

    for (auto& bullet : bullets_) {
        bullet->Update(deltaTime);
    }

    // 蠑ｾ縺ｨ繝悶Ο繝・け縺ｮ蠖薙◆繧雁愛螳・
    stage.ResolveBulletsCollision(GetBulletPtrs());

    bullets_.erase(
        std::remove_if(
            bullets_.begin(),
            bullets_.end(),
            [](const std::unique_ptr<Bullet>& bullet) {
                return bullet->IsDead();
            }
        ),
        bullets_.end()
    );
}

void BulletManager::Draw() {
    for (auto& bullet : bullets_) {
        bullet->Draw();
    }
}

std::vector<Bullet*> BulletManager::GetBulletPtrs() const {
    std::vector<Bullet*> result;
    result.reserve(bullets_.size());
    for (const auto& b : bullets_) {
        result.push_back(b.get());
    }
    return result;
}

void Player::Attack(BulletManager* bulletManager, float deltaTime) {

	// 蠑ｾ縺ｮ繧ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繧ｿ繧､繝繧定ｨ育ｮ励☆繧・
	bulletCoolTime -= deltaTime;
	if (bulletCoolTime > 0.0f) return; // 繧ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繧ｿ繧､繝荳ｭ縺ｯ謚懊￠繧・

	if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {

		if (bulletCoolTime <= 0.0f) {

			// 逋ｺ蟆・ｽ咲ｽｮ
			Vector3 origin = GetWorldPosition();

			// 謾ｻ謦・ヱ繝ｩ繝｡繝ｼ繧ｿ繧定ｨｭ螳・
			AttackParam param{};
			param.bulletSpeed = stats_.bulletSpeed;
			param.bulletCount = 1;
			param.spreadAngleDeg = 5.0f;
			param.randomSpread = false;

			param.reflect = false;
			param.penetrate = false;
			param.cooldown = 1.0f;
			param.damage = static_cast<uint32_t>(stats_.bulletDamage);

			Vector3 recoilDir = Normalize(dir_) * -1.0f;
			float recoilPower = 0.01f; // 蠑ｾ縺ｮ驥阪＆・域・諤ｧ縺ｮ蠑ｷ縺包ｼ・

			// 蛟句挨縺ｫ繧ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繧ｿ繧､繝繧定ｨｭ螳壹☆繧九◆繧√↓蜈医↓險ｭ螳・
			float baseReload = isBuffActive_ ? (stats_.reloadSpeed * 0.7f) / 60.0f : stats_.reloadSpeed / 60.0f;
			bulletCoolTime = baseReload;

			switch (currentClass_) {
			case ClassType::Basic:
				// 譌｢蟄倥・蜊倡匱謾ｻ謦・
				param.spreadAngleDeg = 10.0f;
				param.randomSpread = true;
				bulletCoolTime = baseReload;
				if (isBuffActive_) {
					param.reflect = true;
					bulletCoolTime = baseReload * 0.6f;
					param.spreadAngleDeg = 20.0f;
				}
				attackController_.Fire(origin, dir_, param, BulletOwner::kPlayer);
				
				SpawnCasing(); // 縺薙％縺ｧ蜻ｼ縺ｳ蜃ｺ縺・
				break;

			case ClassType::Twin:
			{
				param.spreadAngleDeg = 2.0f;
				param.randomSpread = true;
				float offsetValue = 0.6f; // 遐ｲ霄ｫ縺ｮ讓ｪ蟷・
				Vector3 rightDir = { -dir_.y, dir_.x, 0.0f }; // dir_縺ｫ蝙ら峩縺ｪ繝吶け繝医Ν・亥承譁ｹ蜷托ｼ・

				if (shootBarrelIndex_ == 0) {
					// 蟾ｦ縺九ｉ逋ｺ蟆・
					attackController_.Fire(origin - rightDir * offsetValue, dir_, param, BulletOwner::kPlayer);
					shootBarrelIndex_ = 1; // 谺｡縺ｯ蜿ｳ
				} else {
					// 蜿ｳ縺九ｉ逋ｺ蟆・
					attackController_.Fire(origin + rightDir * offsetValue, dir_, param, BulletOwner::kPlayer);
					shootBarrelIndex_ = 0; // 谺｡縺ｯ蟾ｦ
				}

				// 繧ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繧ｿ繧､繝繧貞濠蛻・↓縺吶ｋ・・髢蜷医ｏ縺帙※Basic縺ｨ蜷後§遘帝俣逋ｺ蟆・焚縺ｫ縺吶ｋ蝣ｴ蜷茨ｼ・
				bulletCoolTime = baseReload / 2.5f;
			}
			break;

			case ClassType::MachineGun:
				// 隗貞ｺｦ繧偵Λ繝ｳ繝繝縺ｫ縺壹ｉ縺・
				param.spreadAngleDeg = 30.0f;
				param.randomSpread = true;
				attackController_.Fire(origin, dir_, param, BulletOwner::kPlayer);
				// 繝ｪ繝ｭ繝ｼ繝芽｣懈ｭ｣0.6蛟・
				bulletCoolTime = baseReload * 0.6f;
				break;

			case ClassType::Overseer:
				// 蠑ｾ縺ｯ謦・◆縺壹√ラ繝ｭ繝ｼ繝ｳ邂｡逅・未謨ｰ繧貞他縺ｶ
				DroneShoot(bulletManager);
				// 蜿榊虚縺ｪ縺・
				recoilPower = 0.0f;
				break;

			case ClassType::Smasher:
				
				break;
			case ClassType::Triple:
				param.bulletCount = 3;
				param.spreadAngleDeg = 45.0f; // 謇・憾縺ｫ蠎・′繧・
				break;

			case ClassType::Bounder:
				param.reflect = true; // 譌｢蟄倥・繧ｷ繧ｹ繝・Β縺ｫ蜿榊ｰ・ヵ繝ｩ繧ｰ縺後≠繧九◆繧∵怏蜉ｹ蛹・
				param.bulletCount = 1;
				break;

			case ClassType::Assassin:
				// Assassin縺ｯ蠑ｾ騾溘′騾溘＞縺ｪ縺ｩ縺ｮ繝懊・繝翫せ縺後≠縺｣縺ｦ繧り憶縺・
				param.bulletSpeed *= 1.5f;
				isStealth_ = false; // 謦・▲縺溘ｉ隗｣髯､
				stealthTimer_ = 0.0f;
				break;

			case ClassType::Ninja:
				// 謇玖｣丞殴鬚ｨ縺ｫ3縺､諡｡謨｣
				param.bulletCount = 3;
				param.spreadAngleDeg = 15.0f;
				// 繧ｹ繝・Ν繧ｹ隗｣髯､縺ｯ縺励↑縺・莉墓ｧ倬壹ｊ縺ｪ繧画判謦・ｸｭ繧らｶｭ謖・
				break;
			}

			velocity_ += recoilDir * recoilPower;
			Audio::GetInstance()->PlayAudioSE(L"bulletShoot", 0.6f);
		}
	}
}

void Player::DroneShoot(BulletManager* BulletManager)
{

	// 蠑ｾ縺ｮ繧ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繧ｿ繧､繝繧定ｨ育ｮ励☆繧・
	bulletCoolTime--;

	//if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {

	if (drones_.size() >= 7) {
		bulletCoolTime = 0.0f;
		return;
	}

	if (bulletCoolTime <= 0.0f) {

		// 蠑ｾ縺ｮ騾溷ｺｦ
		const float kBulletSpeed = 0.2f;
		Vector3 velocity = dir_ * kBulletSpeed;

		auto drone = std::make_unique<PlayerDrone>();
		drone->Initialize(dir_ * 0.3f + worldTransform_.translate, velocity);
		drone->SetAttackControllerBulletManager(BulletManager);
		drones_.push_back(std::move(drone));

		bulletCoolTime = 1.0f;
	}
	//}
}

void Player::Smash(float deltaTime)
{

	if (isSmash_) {
		return;
	}

	// 繧ｭ繝ｼ繧帝屬縺励◆繧臥ｪ∵茶縺吶ｋ
	if (input_->IsMomentRelease(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
		smashDir_ = dir_;
		isSmash_ = true;
		Vector3 recoilDir = Normalize(smashDir_);
		float recoilPower = easeInQuad(smashCharge_) / 2.0f; // 蠑ｾ縺ｮ驥阪＆・域・諤ｧ縺ｮ蠑ｷ縺包ｼ・
		recoilPower = std::min(recoilPower, 0.7f);
		velocity_ = recoilDir * recoilPower;
		return;
	}

	if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {

		if (isBuffActive_) {
			smashCharge_ += deltaTime * 5.0f;
		} else {
			smashCharge_ += deltaTime;
		}
		if (smashCharge_ >= maxCharge_) {
			smashCharge_ = maxCharge_;
		}
	}
}

Sphere Player::GetSphere() const
{
	Sphere s{};
	s.center = GetWorldPosition();

	// 蜊雁ｾ・・縲梧ｨｪ蟷・渕貅悶阪′螳牙ｮ・
	s.radius = kRadius;

	return s;
}

void Player::AddExp(int amount)
{
	if (level_ >= kMaxLevel) return;

	exp_ += amount;
	// 繝ｬ繝吶Ν繧｢繝・・蛻､螳夲ｼ井ｽ吝臆蛻・ｂ閠・・縺励※繝ｫ繝ｼ繝暦ｼ・
	while (exp_ >= nextLevelExp_) {
		exp_ -= nextLevelExp_;
		level_++;
		// 縺薙％縺ｧ縲後せ繧ｭ繝ｫ繝昴う繝ｳ繝育佐蠕励阪ｄ縲碁ｲ蛹也判髱｢陦ｨ遉ｺ縲阪・繝輔Λ繧ｰ繧堤ｫ九※繧・

		// 谺｡縺ｮ蠢・ｦ∫ｵ碁ｨ灘､繧貞・險育ｮ暦ｼ井ｾ・ 繝ｬ繝吶Ν * 100 + 陬懈ｭ｣・・
		nextLevelExp_ = GetNextLevelExp();

		if (level_ >= kMaxLevel) {
			exp_ = nextLevelExp_; // 繧ｫ繝ｳ繧ｹ繝郁｡ｨ遉ｺ逕ｨ
			break;
		}
	}
}

bool Player::RequestSlow()
{
	if (requestSlow_) {
		requestSlow_ = false;
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}


void Player::RotateToMouse(Camera* viewProjection) {
	// --- 1. 繝槭え繧ｹ蠎ｧ讓吝叙蠕・---
	POINT mousePosition;
	GetCursorPos(&mousePosition);
	HWND hwnd = WinApp::GetInstance()->GetHwnd();
	ScreenToClient(hwnd, &mousePosition);

	// --- 2. 騾・､画鋤逕ｨ縺ｮ陦悟・繧呈ｺ門ｙ ---
	Matrix4x4 matViewport = MakeViewportMatrix(0, 0, WinApp::kClientWidth, WinApp::kClientHeight, 0, 1);
	Matrix4x4 matVPV = viewProjection->GetViewMatrix() * viewProjection->GetProjectionMatrix() * matViewport;
	Matrix4x4 matInverseVPV = Inverse(matVPV);

	// --- 3. 繝槭え繧ｹ蠎ｧ讓吶ｒ繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝峨↓螟画鋤 ---
	Vector3 posNear = Vector3((float)mousePosition.x, (float)mousePosition.y, 0);
	Vector3 posFar = Vector3((float)mousePosition.x, (float)mousePosition.y, 1);

	posNear = TransformMatrix(posNear, matInverseVPV);
	posFar = TransformMatrix(posFar, matInverseVPV);

	// --- 4. 繝ｬ繧､縺ｨ Z=0 蟷ｳ髱｢縺ｮ莠､蟾ｮ ---
	Vector3 mouseDirection = posFar - posNear;
	Vector3 rayDir = Normalize(mouseDirection);
	float t = -posNear.z / rayDir.z;
	Vector3 target = posNear + rayDir * t;

	// --- 5. 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ縺ｨ譁ｹ蜷代・繧ｯ繝医Ν ---
	Vector3 playerPos = worldTransform_.translate;
	Vector3 targetPos = target - playerPos;
	dir_ = Normalize(targetPos);

	// --- 6. 蝗櫁ｻ｢隗貞ｺｦ繧堤ｮ怜・ ---
	angle_ = atan2(dir_.y, dir_.x);
	worldTransform_.rotate.z = angle_;
	object_->SetRotate(worldTransform_.rotate);
}

void Player::Initialize(Object3d* object, const Vector3& position) {

	sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	sprite->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/fade.png");
	sprite->SetColor(Vector4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.8f));

	object_ = object;

	worldTransform_ = InitWorldTransform();
	worldTransform_.translate = position;
	object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	object_->Update();

	for (int i = 0; i < hp_; ++i) {
		auto sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();

		sprite->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(),
			"resources/playerSprite.png");
		sprite->SetPosition({ 40.0f + 50.0f * i, 80.0f });

		hpSprites_.push_back(std::move(sprite));
	}

	hpFont = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	hpFont->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/PlayerHp.png");
	hpFont->SetPosition({ 20.0f, 20.0f });
	hpFont->SetSize({ 120.0f, 40.0f });

	// 繧ｷ繝ｳ繧ｰ繝ｫ繝医Φ繧､繝ｳ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝ｳ繧ｹ
	input_ = Input::GetInstance();

	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｱ樊ｧ繧定ｨｭ螳・
	SetCollisionAttribute(kCollisionAttributePlayer);
	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｯｾ雎｡繧定・蛻・・螻樊ｧ莉･螟悶↓險ｭ螳・
	SetCollisionMask(kCollisionAttributeEnemy | kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet);

	level_ = 15;
	exp_ = 0;
	nextLevelExp_ = GetNextLevelExp();

	machineGunBtnSprite_ = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	machineGunBtnSprite_->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/white512x512.png");
	machineGunBtnSprite_->SetPosition({ btnPos_ });
	machineGunBtnSprite_->SetSize({ btnSize_ });

	InitializeEncyclopedia();

}

void Player::Update(Camera* viewProjection, Stage& stage, BulletManager* BulletManager, float deltaTime)
{
	sprite->Update();

	//POINT mousePos;
	//GetCursorPos(&mousePos);
	//ScreenToClient(WinApp::GetInstance()->GetHwnd(), &mousePos);
	//Vector2 mouseVec = { (float)mousePos.x, (float)mousePos.y };
	//
	//mousePosition_ = mouseVec;
	//
	//UpdateEncyclopedia();
	//
	//if (machineGunBtnSprite_->IsHovered(mouseVec)) {
	//	machineGunBtnSprite_->SetColor(Vector4(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
	//	if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
	//
	//		if (isChangeMode) {
	//			isChangeMode = false;
	//		} else {
	//			isChangeMode = true;
	//		}
	//	}
	//} else {
	//	machineGunBtnSprite_->SetColor(Vector4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
	//}

	//SetDamage(int(stats_.bodyDamage));

	//maxCharge_ -= deltaTime;
	//if (maxCharge_ < 1.0f) {
	//	maxCharge_ = 1.0f;
	//}

	// 繝舌ヵ繧ｿ繧､繝槭・縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ
	if (buffTimer_ > 0.0f) {
		buffTimer_ -= deltaTime;
		SpawnBuffParticle();
		if (buffTimer_ <= 0.0f) {
			isBuffActive_ = false;
			object_->SetColor({ 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f }); // 蜈・・濶ｲ縺ｫ謌ｻ縺・
		}
	}

	//if (isJustEvaded_ && invincibleTimer_ > 0.0f) {
	//	SpawnAfterimage();
	//}

	// 繝舌ヵ繧ｿ繧､繝槭・縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ
	//if (isSmash_) {
	//	// 繝√Ε繝ｼ繧ｸ縺・縺ｧ繧ゅ・溷ｺｦ縺瑚誠縺｡縺溘ｉ繧ｹ繝槭ャ繧ｷ繝･邨ゆｺ・→縺ｿ縺ｪ縺・
	//	smashCharge_ -= deltaTime * 2.0f;
	//	if (smashCharge_ <= 0.0f || Length(velocity_) < 0.1f) {
	//		isSmash_ = false;
	//		smashCharge_ = 0.0f;
	//	}
	//}

	dt_ = deltaTime;

	invincibleTimer_ -= deltaTime;

	if (dashTimer_ > 0.0f) {
		dashTimer_ -= deltaTime;
		SpawnAfterimage();
		if (dashTimer_ <= 0.0f) {
			isDashing_ = false;
			isJustEvaded_ = false;
		}
	}

	if (dashCooldown_ > 0.0f) {
		dashCooldown_ -= deltaTime;
	}

	// 蜿ｳ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝・け縺ｧ繝繝・す繝･
	if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[1], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[1]) && dashCooldown_ <= 0.0f && stats_.stamina >= 1.0f) {

		// 遘ｻ蜍穂ｸｭ縺ｪ繧峨◎縺ｮ譁ｹ蜷代∈縲∵ｭ｢縺ｾ縺｣縺ｦ縺・ｌ縺ｰ蜷代＞縺ｦ縺・ｋ譁ｹ蜷・dir_)縺ｸ繝繝・す繝･
		Vector3 dashDir = inputDir_;
		if (Length(dashDir) < 0.01f) {
			dashDir = dir_;
		}

		// 迸ｬ髢鍋噪縺ｫ騾溷ｺｦ繧剃ｸ頑嶌縺阪√∪縺溘・蠑ｷ縺丞刈邂・
		velocity_ = Normalize(dashDir) * kDashSpeed;

		isDashing_ = true;
		dashTimer_ = kDashDuration;
		dashCooldown_ = kDashCooldown;

		// 繝繝・す繝･縺励◆迸ｬ髢薙↓蟆代＠辟｡謨ｵ縺ｫ縺吶ｋ・医％繧後′蝗樣∩縺ｮ蝓ｺ遉趣ｼ・
		//stats_.stamina -= 1.0f;

	}

	// 繧ｹ繧ｿ繝溘リ蝗槫ｾｩ
	if (!isDashing_) {
		stats_.stamina += stats_.staminaRecovery * deltaTime;
		if (stats_.stamina > stats_.maxStamina) {
			stats_.stamina = stats_.maxStamina;
		}
	}

	UpdateStealth(deltaTime);
	UpdateSummoner(deltaTime);


	// ----------------------
	// 讓ｪ蜈･蜉・
	// ----------------------
	RotateToMouse(viewProjection);
	inputDir_ = { 0,0,0 };

	if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetKey()[DIK_A])) inputDir_.x -= 1.0f;
	if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetKey()[DIK_D])) inputDir_.x += 1.0f;
	if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetKey()[DIK_W])) inputDir_.y += 1.0f;
	if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetKey()[DIK_S])) inputDir_.y -= 1.0f;

	if (Length(inputDir_) > 1.0f) {
		inputDir_ = Normalize(inputDir_);
	}

	// --- 逶ｮ讓咎溷ｺｦ ---
	Vector3 targetVelocity = inputDir_ * maxSpeed_;

	// --- 諷｣諤ｧ蜃ｦ逅・---
	float accel = (Length(inputDir_) > 0.0f) ? accel_ : decel_;

	velocity_ += (targetVelocity - velocity_) * accel * deltaTime;

	float timeWeight = deltaTime * 60.0f;

	// X遘ｻ蜍・
	Vector3 pos = GetWorldPosition();
	pos.x += velocity_.x * timeWeight;
	SetWorldPosition(pos);
	stage.ResolvePlayerCollision(*this, X);

	// Y遘ｻ蜍・
	pos = GetWorldPosition();
	pos.y += velocity_.y * timeWeight;
	SetWorldPosition(pos);
	stage.ResolvePlayerCollision(*this, Y);

	// object_ 縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ縺縺托ｼ育ｧｻ蜍輔・縺励↑縺・ｼ・
	object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	object_->Update();

	if (!isDead_) {
		// 謾ｻ謦・・逅・

		if (currentClass_ == ClassType::Smasher) {
			Smash(deltaTime);
		} else {
			Attack(BulletManager, deltaTime);
		}//DroneShoot(BulletManager);

		for (auto& drone : drones_) {
			drone->Update(viewProjection, stage, worldTransform_.translate);
		}

		drones_.erase(
			std::remove_if(
				drones_.begin(),
				drones_.end(),
				[](const std::unique_ptr<PlayerDrone>& drone) {
					return drone->IsDead();
				}),
			drones_.end());

	}

	for (auto& sprite : hpSprites_) {
		sprite->Update();
	}
	
	Vector3 footPos = GetWorldPosition();
	footPos.y -= 1.0f; // 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ蟆代＠荳九∈繧ｪ繝輔そ繝・ヨ
	footPos.x -= 1.0f;

	// 2. 繧ｹ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝ｼ繝ｳ蠎ｧ讓吶↓螟画鋤
	Vector2 screenBasePos = WorldToScreen(footPos, viewProjection);

	// 3. 3縺､縺ｮ繧ｹ繝励Λ繧､繝医ｒ荳ｭ螟ｮ謠・∴縺ｧ驟咲ｽｮ
	float interval = 25.0f; // 繧｢繧､繧ｳ繝ｳ蜷悟｣ｫ縺ｮ髢馴囈
	float totalWidth = interval * (hpSprites_.size() - 1);
	float startX = screenBasePos.x - (totalWidth / 2.0f);

	for (size_t i = 0; i < hpSprites_.size(); ++i) {
		hpSprites_[i]->SetPosition({ startX + (interval * i), screenBasePos.y });
		hpSprites_[i]->SetSize({ 20.0f, 20.0f }); // 蟆代＠蟆上＆縺上☆繧九→隕九ｄ縺吶＞
		hpSprites_[i]->Update();
	}

	// HP縺ｮ譁・ｭ暦ｼ・ont・峨ｂ雜ｳ蜈・↓鄂ｮ縺上↑繧牙酔讒倥↓縲∽ｸ崎ｦ√↑繧蛾撼陦ｨ遉ｺ縺ｫ
	//hpFont->SetPosition({ screenBasePos.x - 20.0f, screenBasePos.y - 30.0f });
	//hpFont->Update();

	machineGunBtnSprite_->Update();

	if (hp_ <= 0) {
		Die();
	}
	if (isExploding_) {
		UpdateParticles(deltaTime);
	}
	UpdateP(deltaTime);

}

void Player::Draw() {

	// 繝峨Ο繝ｼ繝ｳ縺ｮ謠冗判
	for (auto& drone : drones_) {
		drone->Draw();
	}

	for (auto& p : particles_) {
		p.object->Draw();
	}
	for (auto& p : ps_) {
		p.object->Draw();
	}
	if (!isDead_) {
		// 辟｡謨ｵ譎る俣荳ｭ縺ｯ轤ｹ貊・

		if (invincibleTimer_ > 0.0f && !isJustEvaded_) {
			if (static_cast<int>(invincibleTimer_ * 10) % 5 == 0) {
				// 騾乗・蠎ｦ繧剃ｸ九￡繧・
				if (isStealth_) {
					object_->GetColor().w = 0.2f;
				} else {
					object_->GetColor().w = 0.5f;
				}
				object_->Draw();
				return;
			}
		}
		if (!isStealth_) {
			object_->GetColor().w = 1.0f;
		}
		object_->Draw();
	}

}

void Player::DrawSprite()
{
	for (auto& sprite : hpSprites_) {
		sprite->Draw();
	}
	//hpFont->Draw();

	//DrawEncyclopedia();
	//machineGunBtnSprite_->Draw();

}

std::vector<PlayerDrone*> Player::GetDronePtrs() const {
	std::vector<PlayerDrone*> result;
	result.reserve(drones_.size());
	for (const auto& d : drones_) {
		result.push_back(d.get());
	}
	return result;
}

Vector3 Player::GetWorldPosition() const {

	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶ｒ蜈･繧後ｋ
	Vector3 worldPos;
	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝芽｡悟・縺ｮ蟷ｳ陦檎ｧｻ蜍墓・蛻・ｒ蜿門ｾ・繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓・
	worldPos.x = worldTransform_.translate.x;
	worldPos.y = worldTransform_.translate.y;
	worldPos.z = worldTransform_.translate.z;

	return worldPos;
}

void Player::OnCollision(Collider* other) {

	if (currentClass_ == ClassType::Assassin) {
		isStealth_ = false;
		stealthTimer_ = 0.0f;
	}
	
	if ((invincibleTimer_ > 0.0f && !isDashing_) || isJustEvaded_ || isSmash_) {
		// 辟｡謨ｵ荳ｭ縺ｫ謨ｵ縺ｮ蠑ｾ繧貞女縺代※繧ゅヮ繝・け繝舌ャ繧ｯ縺励↑縺・
		if (other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet) {
			return;
		}
	}

	if (!isJustEvaded_ && isDashing_ && (kDashDuration - dashTimer_) <= kJustEvadeWindow) {
		requestSlow_ = true;
		isJustEvaded_ = true;
		invincibleTimer_ = dashTimer_;
		buffTimer_ = kBuffDuration;
		isBuffActive_ = true;
		// 貍泌・縺ｨ縺励※濶ｲ繧貞､峨∴繧具ｼ井ｾ具ｼ夐≡濶ｲ縺｣縺ｽ縺擾ｼ・
		object_->SetColor({ 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f });
		maxCharge_ = 5.0f;
		return;
	}

	Vector3 hitDir =
		worldTransform_.translate - other->GetWorldPosition();

	if (Length(hitDir) < 0.0001f) {
		return;
	}

	hitDir = Normalize(hitDir);

	const float kKnockBackPower = 0.15f;

	velocity_ += hitDir * kKnockBackPower * other->GetHitPower() * (dt_ * 60.0f);
}

AABB Player::GetAABB() {
	Vector3 worldPos = GetWorldPosition();

	AABB aabb;

	aabb.min = { worldPos.x - kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y - kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z - kWidth / 2.0f };
	aabb.max = { worldPos.x + kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y + kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z + kWidth / 2.0f };

	return aabb;
}

		//if (isDashing_ && (kDashDuration - dashTimer_) <= kJustEvadeWindow) {
		//	requestSlow_ = true;
		//	return;
		//}

		if (hp_ > 0) {
			//hpSprites_.pop_back();
		}

		//hp_--;
		invincibleTimer_ = 2.0f;
	}
}

void Player::Die()
{
	if (isDead_) return;

	isDead_ = true;
	isExploding_ = true;

	SpawnParticles();

	// 縺吶∋縺ｦ縺ｮ蠑ｾ繧呈ｶ医☆
	//bullets_.clear();
}

bool Player::isFinished()
{
	if (isDead_ && !isExploding_) {
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

int Player::GetNextLevelExp() const
{
	// 邁｡譏鍋噪縺ｪ險育ｮ怜ｼ擾ｼ亥ｿ・ｦ√↓蠢懊§縺ｦ隱ｿ謨ｴ・・
	return level_ * 20 + 20;
}
