void Player::InitializeEncyclopedia()
{
	std::vector<TankSeed> seeds = {
		   { ClassType::Basic,      "Basic",      1, "resources/normalTank.png" },
		   { ClassType::Twin,       "Twin",       2, "resources/twin.png" },
		   { ClassType::Overseer,   "Overseer",   2, "resources/drone.png" },
		   { ClassType::MachineGun, "MachineGun", 2, "resources/machineGun.png" },
		   { ClassType::Triple,     "Triple",     3, "resources/normalTank.png" },
		   { ClassType::Assassin,   "Assassin",   3, "resources/normalTank.png" },
		   { ClassType::Bounder,    "Bounder",    3, "resources/normalTank.png" },
		   { ClassType::Ninja,      "Ninja",      4, "resources/normalTank.png" },
		   { ClassType::Smasher,    "Smasher",    4, "resources/normalTank.png" },
		   { ClassType::Summoner,   "Summoner",   4, "resources/normalTank.png" }
	};

	const float kBtnWidth = 165.0f;
	const float kBtnHeight = 54.0f;
	// 髢馴囈繧貞､ｧ蟷・↓蠎・￡繧・
	const float kMarginX = 150.0f;
	const float kMarginY = 80.0f;
	// 逕ｻ髱｢蜈ｨ菴薙・荳ｭ螟ｮ莉倩ｿ托ｼ亥ｷｦ荳雁渕貅厄ｼ・
	const Vector2 kBasePos = { 240.0f, 120.0f };

	// 譌｢蟄倥・繝ｪ繧ｹ繝医ｒ繧ｯ繝ｪ繧｢縺励※蜀肴ｧ狗ｯ・
	encyclopedia_.clear();

	for (int i = 0; i < seeds.size(); ++i) {
		// 譁ｰ縺励＞螳滉ｽ薙ｒ菴懈・
		TankData data;
		data.type = seeds[i].type;
		data.name = seeds[i].name;
		data.requiredRank = seeds[i].requiredRank;
		data.texturePath = seeds[i].texturePath;

		// 繧ｹ繝励Λ繧､繝医・逕滓・
		data.sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
		data.sprite->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), data.texturePath);
		data.sprite->SetSize({ kBtnWidth, kBtnHeight });

		// 繝昴ず繧ｷ繝ｧ繝ｳ險育ｮ・
		Vector2 pos;
		if (i == 0) {
			pos = { kBasePos.x + (kBtnWidth + kMarginX), kBasePos.y };
		} else {
			int row = (i - 1) / 3 + 1;
			int col = (i - 1) % 3;
			pos = { kBasePos.x + (col * (kBtnWidth + kMarginX)), kBasePos.y + (row * (kBtnHeight + kMarginY)) };
		}
		data.sprite->SetPosition(pos);

		// move繧剃ｽｿ縺｣縺ｦvector縺ｫ霑ｽ蜉・医％繧後〒繧ｳ繝斐・繧貞屓驕ｿ・・ｼ・
		encyclopedia_.push_back(std::move(data));
	}
}

void Player::SpawnParticles()
{
	const int particleCount = 30;
	Vector3 center = object_->GetTranslate();

	for (int i = 0; i < particleCount; ++i) {

		PlayerParticle p{};

		p.object = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
		p.object->Initialize();
		p.object->SetModel("playerParticle.obj");

		p.object->SetTranslate(center);

		// ----------------------
		// 繝ｩ繝ｳ繝繝譁ｹ蜷・竊・豁｣隕丞喧
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 dir = Rand(
			Vector3{ -1.0f, -1.0f, -1.0f },
			Vector3{ 1.0f,  1.0f,  1.0f }
		);
		dir = Normalize(dir);

		p.velocity = dir * Rand(3.0f, 6.0f);

		// 蝗櫁ｻ｢騾溷ｺｦ
		p.rotateSpeed = Rand(
			Vector3{ -6.0f, -6.0f, -6.0f },
			Vector3{ 6.0f,  6.0f,  6.0f }
		);

		// ----------------------
		// 蟇ｿ蜻ｽ & 騾乗・蠎ｦ
		// ----------------------
		p.timer = 0.0f;
		p.lifeTime = Rand(0.9f, 1.4f);     // 笘・蛟倶ｽ灘ｷｮ
		p.startAlpha = Rand(0.6f, 1.0f);   // 笘・蛻晄悄繧｢繝ｫ繝輔ぃ

		// Add繝悶Ξ繝ｳ繝画丐縺育畑・亥ｰ代＠譏弱ｋ繧・ｼ・
		Vector4 color = {
			Rand(0.8f, 1.2f),
			Rand(0.8f, 1.2f),
			Rand(0.8f, 1.2f),
			p.startAlpha
		};
		p.object->SetColor(color);

		particles_.push_back(std::move(p));
	}
}

void Player::UpdateParticles(float deltaTime)
{
	for (auto& p : particles_) {

		p.timer += deltaTime;
		if (p.timer >= p.lifeTime) continue;

		float t = p.timer / p.lifeTime; // 0.0 竊・1.0

		// ----------------------
		// 遘ｻ蜍・
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 pos = p.object->GetTranslate();
		pos += p.velocity * deltaTime;

		// 貂幃・
		p.velocity *= 0.97f;

		// 驥榊鴨
		p.velocity.y -= 6.0f * deltaTime;

		// ----------------------
		// 蝗櫁ｻ｢
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 rot = p.object->GetRotate();
		rot += p.rotateSpeed * deltaTime;

		// ----------------------
		// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨い繧ｦ繝・
		// ----------------------
		float alpha = p.startAlpha * (1.0f - t);
		alpha = std::max(alpha, 0.0f);

		Vector4 color = p.object->GetColor();
		color.w = alpha;
		p.object->SetColor(color);

		// ----------------------
		p.object->SetTranslate(pos);
		p.object->SetRotate(rot);
		p.object->Update();
	}

	// 蟇ｿ蜻ｽ蛻・ｌ蜑企勁
	particles_.erase(
		std::remove_if(
			particles_.begin(),
			particles_.end(),
			[](const PlayerParticle& p) {
				return p.timer >= p.lifeTime;
			}),
		particles_.end()
	);

	if (particles_.empty()) {
		isExploding_ = false;
	}
}

void Player::UpdateP(float deltaTime)
{
	for (auto& p : ps_) {

		p.timer += deltaTime;
		if (p.timer >= p.lifeTime) continue;

		float t = p.timer / p.lifeTime; // 0.0 竊・1.0

		// ----------------------
		// 遘ｻ蜍・
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 pos = p.object->GetTranslate();
		pos += p.velocity * deltaTime;

		// 貂幃・
		p.velocity *= 0.97f;

		// 驥榊鴨
		p.velocity.y -= 6.0f * deltaTime;

		// ----------------------
		// 蝗櫁ｻ｢
		// ----------------------
		Vector3 rot = p.object->GetRotate();
		rot += p.rotateSpeed * deltaTime;

		// ----------------------
		// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨い繧ｦ繝・
		// ----------------------
		float alpha = p.startAlpha * (1.0f - t);
		alpha = std::max(alpha, 0.0f);

		Vector4 color = p.object->GetColor();
		color.w = alpha;
		p.object->SetColor(color);

		// ----------------------
		p.object->SetTranslate(pos);
		p.object->SetRotate(rot);
		p.object->Update();
	}

	// 蟇ｿ蜻ｽ蛻・ｌ蜑企勁
	ps_.erase(
		std::remove_if(
			ps_.begin(),
			ps_.end(),
			[](const PlayerParticle& p) {
				return p.timer >= p.lifeTime;
			}),
		ps_.end()
	);

}

void Player::UpdateEncyclopedia()
{
	int currentRank = GetRankFromLevel(this->level_);

	for (auto& tank : encyclopedia_) {
		// 繝ｩ繝ｳ繧ｯ縺瑚ｶｳ繧翫※縺・ｋ縺・
		bool isAvailable = (currentRank >= tank.requiredRank);

		if (isAvailable) {
			// 繝帙ヰ繝ｼ蛻､螳夲ｼ育樟蝨ｨ縺ｮ繝懊ち繝ｳ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ縺ｨ繧ｵ繧､繧ｺ縺ｧ蛻､螳夲ｼ・
			if (tank.sprite->IsHovered(mousePosition_)) {
				tank.sprite->SetColor({ 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.8f }); // 繝帙ヰ繝ｼ譎ゅ・邱・
				if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) { // 蟾ｦ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝・け譎・
					Evolve(tank.type);
				}
			} else {
				tank.sprite->SetColor({ 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.8f }); // 騾壼ｸｸ
			}
		} else {
			tank.sprite->SetColor({ 0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f, 0.3f }); // 繝ｭ繝・け荳ｭ・域囓縺上・蜊企乗・・・
		}

		tank.sprite->Update(); // 繧ｨ繝ｳ繧ｸ繝ｳ縺ｮ莉墓ｧ倥↓蜷医ｏ縺帙※Update繧貞他縺ｶ
	}
}

void Player::DrawEncyclopedia() {

	if (isChangeMode) {
		sprite->Draw();

		for (auto& tank : encyclopedia_) {
			tank.sprite->Draw(); // 蜷・せ繝励Λ繧､繝医′謖√▽菴咲ｽｮ縺ｧ謠冗判
		}
	}
}

int Player::GetRankFromLevel(int level) {
	if (level >= 15) return 4;
	if (level >= 10) return 3;
	if (level >= 5) return 2;
	return 1;
}

void Player::UpdateStealth(float deltaTime) {
	// Assassin縺ｮ莉墓ｧ・ 縺励・繧峨￥邨後▽縺ｨ繧ｹ繝・Ν繧ｹ
	if (currentClass_ == ClassType::Assassin) {
		// 遘ｻ蜍募・蜉帙′縺ゅｋ縺九∵判謦・＠縺ｦ縺・ｋ縺九ｒ繝√ぉ繝・け
		if (Length(velocity_) > 0.1f || input_->IsPress(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
			stealthTimer_ = 0.0f;
			isStealth_ = false;
		} else {
			stealthTimer_ += deltaTime;
			if (stealthTimer_ >= 2.0f) { // 2遘帝撕豁｢縺ｧ繧ｹ繝・Ν繧ｹ
				isStealth_ = true;
			}
		}
	}

	// Ninja縺ｮ莉墓ｧ・ 繝繝・す繝･縺ｾ縺溘・繧ｸ繝｣繧ｹ繝亥屓驕ｿ縺ｧ繧ｹ繝・Ν繧ｹ
	if (currentClass_ == ClassType::Ninja) {
		if (isDashing_ || isJustEvaded_) {
			isStealth_ = true;
			stealthTimer_ = 1.5f; // 1.5遘帝俣謖∫ｶ・
		}

		if (stealthTimer_ > 0) {
			stealthTimer_ -= deltaTime;
		} else {
			isStealth_ = false;
		}
	}

	// 繧｢繝ｫ繝輔ぃ蛟､縺ｮ驕ｩ逕ｨ (謠冗判譎ゅ↓蜿肴丐縺輔○繧・
	float targetAlpha = isStealth_ ? 0.2f : 1.0f;
	stealthAlpha_ = Lerp(stealthAlpha_, targetAlpha, 0.1f);
	// 螳滄圀縺ｮ繝｢繝・Ν縺ｮ繧ｫ繝ｩ繝ｼ縺ｫ驕ｩ逕ｨ
	object_->SetAlpha(stealthAlpha_);
}

void Player::UpdateSummoner(float deltaTime) {
	if (currentClass_ != ClassType::Summoner) return;

	// 繝峨Ο繝ｼ繝ｳ縺ｮ謨ｰ縺瑚ｶｳ繧翫↑縺代ｌ縺ｰ逕滓・
	if (drones_.size() < kMaxSummonerDrones) {
		summonTimer_ += deltaTime;
		if (summonTimer_ > 2.0f) {
			// 繝峨Ο繝ｼ繝ｳ繧堤函謌舌＠縺ｦ繝ｪ繧ｹ繝医↓霑ｽ蜉縺吶ｋ蜃ｦ逅・
			// drones_.push_back(std::make_unique<PlayerDrone>(...));
			summonTimer_ = 0.0f;
		}
	}
}

// 阮ｬ闔｢・医せ繝｢繝ｼ繝ｫ繝代・繝・ぅ繧ｯ繝ｫ・峨ｒ逕滓・縺吶ｋ豎守畑髢｢謨ｰ
void Player::SpawnCasing() {
	for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
		PlayerParticle p{};
		p.object = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
		p.object->Initialize();
		p.object->SetModel("playerParticle.obj"); // 阮ｬ闔｢逕ｨ縺ｮ邏ｰ髟ｷ縺・Δ繝・Ν縺後≠繧後・繝吶せ繝・

		// 1. 逋ｺ蟆・ｽ咲ｽｮ・医・繝ｬ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ・・
		Vector3 origin = GetWorldPosition();
		p.object->SetTranslate(origin + (dir_ * 1.0f));

		// 2. 謗貞・譁ｹ蜷代・險育ｮ・(騾ｲ陦梧婿蜷・dir_ 縺ｫ蟇ｾ縺励※蜿ｳ蠕後ｍ縺ｫ鬟帙・縺・
		// dir_ = {x, y, 0} 縺ｨ諠ｳ螳・
		Vector3 ejectDir = { -dir_.y, dir_.x, 0.0f }; // 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ蜿ｳ譁ｹ蜷・
		ejectDir = Normalize(ejectDir + (dir_ * -0.5f)); // 蟆代＠蠕後ｍ縺ｫ蛯ｾ縺代ｋ

		// 3. 蛻晞溘→蝗櫁ｻ｢
		float speed = Rand(2.0f, 4.0f);
		p.velocity = ejectDir * speed;
		p.rotateSpeed = Rand(Vector3{ -10.0f, -10.0f, -10.0f }, Vector3{ 10.0f, 10.0f, 10.0f });

		// 4. 蟇ｿ蜻ｽ縺ｨ濶ｲ・郁脈闔｢縺｣縺ｽ縺城ｻ・牡繝ｻ繧ｪ繝ｬ繝ｳ繧ｸ邉ｻ縺ｫ・・
		p.timer = 0.0f;
		p.lifeTime = Rand(0.5f, 0.8f);
		p.startAlpha = 1.0f;
		p.object->SetColor({ 1.0f, 0.8f, 0.2f, 1.0f }); // 驥題牡
		p.object->SetScale({ 0.4f, 0.4f, 0.4f });      // 蟆上＆縺上☆繧・

		ps_.push_back(std::move(p));
	}
}

// 谿句ワ繧堤函謌舌☆繧矩未謨ｰ
void Player::SpawnAfterimage() {
	PlayerParticle p{};
	p.object = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
	p.object->Initialize();

	// 迴ｾ蝨ｨ縺ｮ繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｨ蜷後§繝｢繝・Ν縺ｨ繝医Λ繝ｳ繧ｹ繝輔か繝ｼ繝繧定ｨｭ螳・
	p.object->SetModel("player.obj"); // 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ繝｢繝・Ν蜷阪↓蜷医ｏ縺帙※縺上□縺輔＞
	p.object->SetTranslate(worldTransform_.translate);
	p.object->SetRotate(worldTransform_.rotate);
	p.object->SetScale(worldTransform_.scale);

	// 谿句ワ縺ｪ縺ｮ縺ｧ蜍輔°縺輔↑縺・
	p.velocity = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
	p.rotateSpeed = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };

	p.timer = 0.0f;
	p.lifeTime = 0.4f; // 遏ｭ繧√↓豸医∴繧・
	p.startAlpha = 0.5f;

	// 繧ｸ繝｣繧ｹ繝亥屓驕ｿ荳ｭ縺ｪ繧臥ｷ・驥代・壼ｸｸ縺ｮ繝繝・す繝･縺ｪ繧蛾搨縺｣縺ｽ縺上☆繧九↑縺ｩ
	if (isJustEvaded_) {
		p.object->SetColor({ 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.5f, 0.4f }); // 繧ｸ繝｣繧ｹ繝亥屓驕ｿ・壹お繝｡繝ｩ繝ｫ繝・
	} else {
		p.object->SetColor({ 0.5f, 0.5f, 1.0f, 0.3f }); // 騾壼ｸｸ繝繝・す繝･・夊埋縺・搨
	}

	ps_.push_back(std::move(p));
}

// 繝舌ヵ荳ｭ縺ｮ邊貞ｭ舌ｒ逕滓・
void Player::SpawnBuffParticle() {
	PlayerParticle p{};
	p.object = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
	p.object->Initialize();
	p.object->SetModel("playerParticle.obj");

	// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ雜ｳ蜈・ｻ倩ｿ代°繧峨Λ繝ｳ繝繝縺ｫ逋ｺ逕・
	Vector3 offset = { Rand(-0.5f, 0.5f), -0.5f, Rand(-0.5f, 0.5f) };
	p.object->SetTranslate(GetWorldPosition() + offset);

	// 荳翫↓蜷代°縺｣縺ｦ譏・▲縺ｦ縺・￥・磯㍾蜉帙↓騾・ｉ縺・・騾溘ｒ荳弱∴繧具ｼ・
	p.velocity = { Rand(-0.2f, 0.2f), Rand(2.0f, 4.0f), 0.0f };
	p.rotateSpeed = Rand(Vector3{ -5,-5,-5 }, Vector3{ 5,5,5 });

	p.timer = 0.0f;
	p.lifeTime = Rand(0.6f, 1.0f);
	p.startAlpha = 1.0f;

	// 繝舌ヵ縺ｮ濶ｲ・磯ｮｮ繧・°縺ｪ邱代ｄ鮟・牡・・
	p.object->SetColor({ 0.2f, 1.0f, 0.2f, 1.0f });
	p.object->SetScale({ 0.3f, 0.3f, 0.3f });

	ps_.push_back(std::move(p));
}
Vector2 Player::WorldToScreen(const Vector3& worldPos, Camera* camera) {
	// 1. 繝薙Η繝ｼ繝励Ο繧ｸ繧ｧ繧ｯ繧ｷ繝ｧ繝ｳ陦悟・縺ｧ螟画鋤
	//Matrix4x4 matViewport = MakeViewportMatrix(0, 0, WinApp::kClientWidth, WinApp::kClientHeight, 0, 1);
	Matrix4x4 matVP = camera->GetViewMatrix() * camera->GetProjectionMatrix();
	Vector3 ndcPos = TransformMatrix(worldPos, matVP);

	// 2. NDC蠎ｧ讓・(-1.0 ~ 1.0) 繧偵せ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝ｼ繝ｳ蠎ｧ讓・(0 ~ 繧ｦ繧｣繝ｳ繝峨え蟷・鬮・ 縺ｫ螟画鋤
	// 窶ｻ WinApp縺ｪ縺ｩ縺ｮ繧ｷ繝ｳ繧ｰ繝ｫ繝医Φ縺九ｉ逕ｻ髱｢繧ｵ繧､繧ｺ繧貞叙蠕励＠縺ｦ縺上□縺輔＞
	float screenX = (ndcPos.x + 1.0f) * 0.5f * WinApp::kClientWidth;
	float screenY = (1.0f - ndcPos.y) * 0.5f * WinApp::kClientHeight;

	return { screenX, screenY };
}

#include "PlayerDrone.h"

PlayerDrone::~PlayerDrone() {

}

void PlayerDrone::Attack() {

	// 蠑ｾ縺ｮ繧ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繧ｿ繧､繝繧定ｨ育ｮ励☆繧・
	bulletCoolTime--;

	if (input_->IsPress(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {

		if (bulletCoolTime <= 0) {

			// 逋ｺ蟆・ｽ咲ｽｮ
			Vector3 origin = GetWorldPosition();

			// 謾ｻ謦・ヱ繝ｩ繝｡繝ｼ繧ｿ繧定ｨｭ螳・
			AttackParam param{};
			param.bulletSpeed = 0.4f;
			param.bulletCount = 1;
			param.spreadAngleDeg = 20.0f;
			param.randomSpread = true;

			param.reflect = false;
			param.penetrate = false;
			param.cooldown = 1.0f;
			param.damage = 1;

			// 逋ｺ蟆・
			attackController_.Fire(
				origin,
				dir,
				param,
				BulletOwner::kPlayer
			);
			bulletCoolTime = kBulletTime;
		}
	}
}

void PlayerDrone::RotateToMouse(Camera* viewProjection) {
	// --- 1. 繝槭え繧ｹ蠎ｧ讓吝叙蠕・---
	POINT mousePosition;
	GetCursorPos(&mousePosition);
	HWND hwnd = WinApp::GetInstance()->GetHwnd();
	ScreenToClient(hwnd, &mousePosition);

	// --- 2. 騾・､画鋤逕ｨ縺ｮ陦悟・繧呈ｺ門ｙ ---
	Matrix4x4 matViewport = MakeViewportMatrix(0, 0, WinApp::kClientWidth, WinApp::kClientHeight, 0, 1);
	Matrix4x4 matVPV = viewProjection->GetViewMatrix() * viewProjection->GetProjectionMatrix() * matViewport;
	Matrix4x4 matInverseVPV = Inverse(matVPV);

	// --- 3. 繝槭え繧ｹ蠎ｧ讓吶ｒ繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝峨↓螟画鋤 ---
	Vector3 posNear = Vector3((float)mousePosition.x, (float)mousePosition.y, 0);
	Vector3 posFar = Vector3((float)mousePosition.x, (float)mousePosition.y, 1);

	posNear = TransformMatrix(posNear, matInverseVPV);
	posFar = TransformMatrix(posFar, matInverseVPV);

	// --- 4. 繝ｬ繧､縺ｨ Z=0 蟷ｳ髱｢縺ｮ莠､蟾ｮ ---
	Vector3 mouseDirection = posFar - posNear;
	Vector3 rayDir = Normalize(mouseDirection);
	float t = -posNear.z / rayDir.z;
	Vector3 target = posNear + rayDir * t;

	// --- 5. 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｮ菴咲ｽｮ縺ｨ譁ｹ蜷代・繧ｯ繝医Ν ---
	Vector3 playerPos = worldTransform_.translate;
	Vector3 targetPos = target - playerPos;
	dir = Normalize(targetPos);

	// --- 6. 蝗櫁ｻ｢隗貞ｺｦ繧堤ｮ怜・ ---
	angle_ = atan2(dir.y, dir.x);
	worldTransform_.rotate.z = angle_;
	object_->SetRotate(worldTransform_.rotate);
}

void PlayerDrone::Initialize(const Vector3& position, const Vector3& velocity) {
	
	object_ = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
	object_->Initialize();

	object_->SetModel("enemy.obj");
	
	worldTransform_ = InitWorldTransform();
	worldTransform_.translate = position;
	object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	object_->Update();

	velocity_ = velocity;

	// 繧ｷ繝ｳ繧ｰ繝ｫ繝医Φ繧､繝ｳ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝ｳ繧ｹ
	input_ = Input::GetInstance();

	SetDamage(1);

	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｱ樊ｧ繧定ｨｭ螳・
	SetCollisionAttribute(kCollisionAttributePlayerDrone);
	// 陦晉ｪ∝ｯｾ雎｡繧定・蛻・↓險ｭ螳・
	SetCollisionMask(kCollisionAttributePlayerDrone | kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet | kCollisionAttributeEnemy);
}

void PlayerDrone::Update(Camera* viewProjection, Stage& stage, const Vector3& playerPosition)
{
	invincibleTimer_ -= 1.0f / 60.0f;

	RotateToMouse(viewProjection);

	Vector3 toPlayer = playerPosition - worldTransform_.translate;

	float distance = Length(toPlayer);
	if (distance < 0.01f) {
		return;
	}

	Vector3 dir = Normalize(toPlayer);
	
	// --- 逶ｮ讓咎溷ｺｦ ---
	Vector3 targetVelocity = dir * maxSpeed_;

	// --- 諷｣諤ｧ蜃ｦ逅・---
	float dt = 1.0f / 60.0f;
	float accel = (Length(dir) > 0.0f) ? accel_ : decel_;

	velocity_ += (targetVelocity - velocity_) * accel * dt;

	// X霆ｸ遘ｻ蜍・
	Vector3 playerPos = GetWorldPosition();
	playerPos.x += GetMove().x;
	SetWorldPosition(playerPos);
	stage.ResolvePlayerDroneCollision(*this, X);

	// Y霆ｸ遘ｻ蜍・
	playerPos = GetWorldPosition();
	playerPos.y += GetMove().y;
	SetWorldPosition(playerPos);
	stage.ResolvePlayerDroneCollision(*this, Y);
	
	Vector3 pos = GetWorldPosition();

	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶°繧峨・繝・・繧､繝ｳ繝・ャ繧ｯ繧ｹ縺ｫ螟画鋤
	int xIndex = static_cast<int>(pos.x / 2.0f); // kBlockWidth = 2.0f
	int yIndex = static_cast<int>(19 - (pos.y / 2.0f)); // kNumBlockVirtical - 1 = 19, kBlockHeight = 2.0f

	// Stage繧ｯ繝ｩ繧ｹ縺ｫ蛻､螳夂畑髢｢謨ｰ縺後≠繧句ｴ蜷医・萓・
	// if (stage.GetMapChipType(pos) == MapChipType::kDamageBlock) { Die(); }

	// 逶ｴ謗･MapChip繝・・繧ｿ繧貞盾辣ｧ縺吶ｋ蝣ｴ蜷医・邁｡譏灘愛螳夲ｼ・apChip縺ｮ繧､繝ｳ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝ｳ繧ｹ縺悟ｿ・ｦ・ｼ・
	if (xIndex < 0 || xIndex >= 30 || yIndex < 0 || yIndex >= 20) {
		Die(); // 縺昴ｂ縺昴ｂ繝槭ャ繝鈴・蛻励・遽・峇螟悶↑繧画ｭｻ莠｡
	} else {
		// 繝槭ャ繝励・蛟､繧堤峩謗･繝√ぉ繝・け・・tage邨檎罰縺ｧMapChip繧貞叙蠕励☆繧区Φ螳夲ｼ・
		// MapChipType type = stage.GetMapChip().GetMapChipTypeByIndex(xIndex, yIndex);
		// if (type == MapChipType::kDamageBlock) { Die(); }
	}

	// object_ 縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ縺縺托ｼ育ｧｻ蜍輔・縺励↑縺・ｼ・
	object_->SetTransform(worldTransform_);
	object_->Update();

	if (!isDead_) {
		// 謾ｻ謦・・逅・
		Attack();
	}

	if (hp_ <= 0) {
		Die();
	}
}

void PlayerDrone::Draw() {

	if (!isDead_) {
		// 辟｡謨ｵ譎る俣荳ｭ縺ｯ轤ｹ貊・

		if (invincibleTimer_ > 0.0f) {
			if (static_cast<int>(invincibleTimer_ * 10) % 2 == 0) {
				return;
			}
		}
		object_->Draw();
	}
}

void PlayerDrone::DrawSprite()
{
}

Vector3 PlayerDrone::GetWorldPosition() const {

	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶ｒ蜈･繧後ｋ
	Vector3 worldPos;
	// 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝芽｡悟・縺ｮ蟷ｳ陦檎ｧｻ蜍墓・蛻・ｒ蜿門ｾ・繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓・
	worldPos.x = worldTransform_.translate.x;
	worldPos.y = worldTransform_.translate.y;
	worldPos.z = worldTransform_.translate.z;

	return worldPos;
}

void PlayerDrone::OnCollision(Collider* other) {

	if (other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributeEnemyBullet || other->GetCollisionAttribute() == kCollisionAttributeEnemy) {
		hp_--;
	}

	Vector3 hitDir =
		worldTransform_.translate - other->GetWorldPosition();

	if (Length(hitDir) < 0.0001f) {
		return;
	}

	hitDir = Normalize(hitDir);

	const float kKnockBackPower = 0.1f;

	velocity_ += hitDir * kKnockBackPower * other->GetHitPower();
}

AABB PlayerDrone::GetAABB() {
	Vector3 worldPos = GetWorldPosition();

	AABB aabb;

	aabb.min = { worldPos.x - kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y - kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z - kWidth / 2.0f };
	aabb.max = { worldPos.x + kWidth / 2.0f, worldPos.y + kHeight / 2.0f, worldPos.z + kWidth / 2.0f };

	return aabb;
}

void PlayerDrone::Damage()
{
	if (invincibleTimer_ <= 0.0f) {
		if (hp_ > 0) {
		}
		hp_--;
		invincibleTimer_ = 2.0f;
	}
}

void PlayerDrone::Die()
{
	if (isDead_) return;

	isDead_ = true;
}

#include "Stage.h"

void Stage::Initialize() {

	mapChip_ = std::make_unique<MapChip>();
	mapChip_->LoadMapChipCsv("resources/map.csv");
	GenerateBlocks();
}

void Stage::Update() {}

void Stage::Draw() {
	for (auto& line : blocks_) {
		for (auto& block : line) {
			if (!block.isActive) continue;

			block.object->Update();
			block.object->Draw();
		}
	}
}

void Stage::GenerateBlocks() {

	uint32_t numBlockHorizontal = mapChip_->GetNumBlockHorizontal();
	uint32_t numBlockVirtical = mapChip_->GetNumBlockVirtical();

	blocks_.resize(numBlockVirtical);
	for (uint32_t y = 0; y < numBlockVirtical; ++y) {
		blocks_[y].resize(numBlockHorizontal);
	}

	for (uint32_t y = 0; y < numBlockVirtical; ++y) {
		for (uint32_t x = 0; x < numBlockHorizontal; ++x) {

			if (mapChip_->GetMapChipTypeByIndex(x, y) == MapChipType::kBlock || mapChip_->GetMapChipTypeByIndex(x, y) == MapChipType::kDamageBlock) {

				Block& block = blocks_[y][x];

				block.worldTransform = InitWorldTransform();
				block.worldTransform.translate = mapChip_->GetMapChipPositionByIndex(x, y);
				block.object = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
				block.object->Initialize();
				if (mapChip_->GetMapChipTypeByIndex(x, y) == MapChipType::kBlock) {
					block.object->SetModel("cube.obj");
				} else {
					block.object->SetModel("cubeDamage.obj");
				}

				block.object->SetTransform(block.worldTransform);

				// 荳ｭ蠢・ｺｧ讓・
				const auto& pos = block.worldTransform.translate;

				// AABB險ｭ螳・
				block.aabb.min = { pos.x - mapChip_->kBlockWidth / 2.0f, pos.y - mapChip_->kBlockHeight / 2.0f, pos.z - mapChip_->kBlockWidth / 2.0f };
				block.aabb.max = { pos.x + mapChip_->kBlockWidth / 2.0f, pos.y + mapChip_->kBlockHeight / 2.0f, pos.z + mapChip_->kBlockWidth / 2.0f };
				
				// OBB險ｭ螳・
				block.originalPos = pos;
				block.obb.center = pos;
				
				block.obb.halfExtents = {
					mapChip_->kBlockWidth * 0.5f,
					mapChip_->kBlockHeight * 0.5f,
					mapChip_->kBlockWidth * 0.5f
				};
				float rad = 45.0f * (3.14159265f / 180.0f);

				//// 霆ｸ縺ｯ繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙渕貅厄ｼ井ｻ翫・蝗槭＆縺ｪ縺・ｼ・
				block.obb.orientation[0] = { 1, 0, 0 };
				block.obb.orientation[1] = { 0, 1, 0 };
				block.obb.orientation[2] = { 0, 0, 1 };
				block.isActive = true;
				block.type = mapChip_->GetMapChipTypeByIndex(x, y);
			}
		}
	}

	// 繝悶Ο繝・け邨ｱ蜷亥・逅・
	auto FixAABB = [](AABB& aabb) {
		if (aabb.min.x > aabb.max.x)
			std::swap(aabb.min.x, aabb.max.x);
		if (aabb.min.y > aabb.max.y)
			std::swap(aabb.min.y, aabb.max.y);
		if (aabb.min.z > aabb.max.z)
			std::swap(aabb.min.z, aabb.max.z);
		};

	mergedBlocks_.clear();
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < numBlockVirtical; ++i) {
		bool merging = false;
		AABB mergedAABB{};
		MapChipType currentType{};

		for (uint32_t j = 0; j < numBlockHorizontal; ++j) {
			const Block& block = blocks_[i][j];

			if (block.isActive) {
				if (!merging) {
					mergedAABB = block.aabb;
					currentType = block.type;
					merging = true;
				}
				// 繧ｿ繧､繝励′蜷後§縺ｪ繧臥ｵｱ蜷・
				else if (block.type == currentType) {
					mergedAABB.max.x = block.aabb.max.x;
				}
				// 繧ｿ繧､繝励′驕輔≧縺ｪ繧臥｢ｺ螳・
				else {
					mergedBlocks_.push_back({ mergedAABB, currentType });
					mergedAABB = block.aabb;
					currentType = block.type;
				}
			} else if (merging) {
				mergedBlocks_.push_back({ mergedAABB, currentType });
				merging = false;
			}
		}

		if (merging) {
			mergedBlocks_.push_back({ mergedAABB, currentType });
		}
	}
}

void Stage::ResolvePlayerCollision(Player& player, AxisXYZ axis)
{

	AABB playerAABB = player.GetAABB();
	Vector3 playerPos = player.GetWorldPosition();
	Vector3 velocity = player.GetMove();

	const float kEpsilon = 0.01f;

	for (const MergedBlock& block : mergedBlocks_) {

		if (!IsCollision(playerAABB, block.aabb)) {
			continue;
		}

		// 繝繝｡繝ｼ繧ｸ蠎・
		if (block.type == MapChipType::kDamageBlock) {
			//if (!enemy.IsDead()) {
			player.Damage();
			//}
		}

		Vector3 overlap = {
			std::min(playerAABB.max.x, block.aabb.max.x) - std::max(playerAABB.min.x, block.aabb.min.x),
			std::min(playerAABB.max.y, block.aabb.max.y) - std::max(playerAABB.min.y, block.aabb.min.y),
			0.0f
		};

		// --------------------
		// X譁ｹ蜷題｡晉ｪ・
		// --------------------
		if (axis == X) {
			if (playerAABB.min.x < block.aabb.min.x) {
				playerPos.x -= overlap.x + kEpsilon;
			} else {
				playerPos.x += overlap.x + kEpsilon;
			}
			velocity.x = 0.0f;
		}

		// --------------------
		// Y譁ｹ蜷題｡晉ｪ・
		// --------------------
		if (axis == Y) {
			if (playerAABB.min.y < block.aabb.min.y) {
				playerPos.y -= overlap.y + kEpsilon;
			} else {
				playerPos.y += overlap.y + kEpsilon;
				player.SetOnGround(true);
			}
			velocity.y = 0.0f;
		}

		player.SetWorldPosition(playerPos);
		player.SetVelocity(velocity);
		playerAABB = player.GetAABB();
	}
}

void Stage::ResolvePlayerDroneCollision(PlayerDrone& playerDrone, AxisXYZ axis)
{

	AABB playerAABB = playerDrone.GetAABB();
	Vector3 playerPos = playerDrone.GetWorldPosition();
	Vector3 velocity = playerDrone.GetMove();

	const float kEpsilon = 0.01f;

	for (const MergedBlock& block : mergedBlocks_) {

		if (!IsCollision(playerAABB, block.aabb)) {
			continue;
		}

		// 繝繝｡繝ｼ繧ｸ蠎・
		if (block.type == MapChipType::kDamageBlock) {
			//if (!enemy.IsDead()) {
			//	player.Damage();
			//}
		}

		Vector3 overlap = {
			std::min(playerAABB.max.x, block.aabb.max.x) - std::max(playerAABB.min.x, block.aabb.min.x),
			std::min(playerAABB.max.y, block.aabb.max.y) - std::max(playerAABB.min.y, block.aabb.min.y),
			0.0f
		};

		// --------------------
		// X譁ｹ蜷題｡晉ｪ・
		// --------------------
		if (axis == X) {
			if (playerAABB.min.x < block.aabb.min.x) {
				playerPos.x -= overlap.x + kEpsilon;
			} else {
				playerPos.x += overlap.x + kEpsilon;
			}
			velocity.x = 0.0f;
		}

		// --------------------
		// Y譁ｹ蜷題｡晉ｪ・

}

void Stage::ResolveEnemyCollision(Enemy& enemy, AxisXYZ axis)
{
	AABB enemyAABB = enemy.GetAABB();
	Vector3 enemyPos = enemy.GetWorldPosition();
	const float kEpsilon = 0.01f;
	//bool hit = false;

	for (const MergedBlock& block : mergedBlocks_) {

		if (!IsCollision(enemyAABB, block.aabb)) {
			continue;
		}

		//hit = true;

		Vector3 overlap = {
			std::min(enemyAABB.max.x, block.aabb.max.x) - std::max(enemyAABB.min.x, block.aabb.min.x),
			std::min(enemyAABB.max.y, block.aabb.max.y) - std::max(enemyAABB.min.y, block.aabb.min.y),
			0.0f
		};

		if (axis == X) {
			enemyPos.x += (enemyAABB.min.x < block.aabb.min.x)
				? -(overlap.x + kEpsilon)
				: +(overlap.x + kEpsilon);
		} else if (axis == Y) {
			enemyPos.y += (enemyAABB.min.y < block.aabb.min.y)
				? -(overlap.y + kEpsilon)
				: +(overlap.y + kEpsilon);
		}

		enemy.SetWorldPosition(enemyPos);
		enemyAABB = enemy.GetAABB();
	}
}

{
	AABB enemyAABB = enemy.GetAABB();
	Vector3 enemyPos = enemy.GetWorldPosition();
	const float kEpsilon = 0.01f;
	//bool hit = false;

	for (const MergedBlock& block : mergedBlocks_) {

		if (!IsCollision(enemyAABB, block.aabb)) {
			continue;
		}

		//hit = true;

		Vector3 overlap = {
			std::min(enemyAABB.max.x, block.aabb.max.x) - std::max(enemyAABB.min.x, block.aabb.min.x),
			std::min(enemyAABB.max.y, block.aabb.max.y) - std::max(enemyAABB.min.y, block.aabb.min.y),
			0.0f
		};

		if (axis == X) {

				? -(overlap.x + kEpsilon)

				? -(overlap.y + kEpsilon)

		}

		enemy.SetWorldPosition(enemyPos);
		enemyAABB = enemy.GetAABB();
	}
}

void Stage::ResolveBulletsCollision(const std::vector<Bullet*>& bullets)
{
	for (Bullet* bullet : bullets) {
		if (!bullet || bullet->IsDead()) continue;

		Vector3 bulletPos = bullet->GetWorldPosition();
		float radius = bullet->GetRadius();
		Sphere bulletSphere{ bulletPos, radius };

		bool isCollided = false;
		float nearestDist = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
		Vector3 nearestClosestPoint{};
		Vector3 nearestNormal{};

		for (const auto& block : mergedBlocks_) {

			if (!IsCollision(block.aabb, bulletSphere)) continue;

			Vector3 closestPoint{
				std::clamp(bulletSphere.center.x, block.aabb.min.x, block.aabb.max.x),
				std::clamp(bulletSphere.center.y, block.aabb.min.y, block.aabb.max.y),
				std::clamp(bulletSphere.center.z, block.aabb.min.z, block.aabb.max.z)
			};

			// 蟾ｮ蛻・・繧ｯ繝医Ν繧定ｨ育ｮ・
			Vector3 diff = bulletSphere.center - closestPoint;
			diff.z = 0.0f; // 2D逧・↑蜃ｦ逅・・縺溘ａZ繧堤┌隕・

			float dist = Length(diff);

			// 笘・ｿｮ豁｣繝昴う繝ｳ繝茨ｼ壼ｮ悟・縺ｫ蝓九∪縺｣縺ｦ縺・ｋ・井ｸｭ蠢・′繝悶Ο繝・け蜀・ｼ牙ｴ蜷・
			if (dist < 0.0001f) {
				// 荳ｭ蠢・′蝓九∪縺｣縺ｦ縺・ｋ・晏叉豁ｻ縺輔○繧九・縺御ｸ逡ｪ螳牙・
				bullet->Die();

				// 繧ゅ≧豁ｻ繧薙□縺ｮ縺ｧ險育ｮ礼ｵゆｺ・ヵ繝ｩ繧ｰ繧堤ｫ九※縺ｦ繝ｫ繝ｼ繝励ｒ謚懊￠繧・
				isCollided = false;
				break;
			}

			// 縺薙％縺ｾ縺ｧ譚･縺溘ｉ縲悟､門・縺ｧ謗･縺励※縺・ｋ縲阪・縺ｧ豁｣隕丞喧縺ｧ縺阪ｋ
			Vector3 normal = Normalize(diff);

			if (dist < nearestDist) {
				nearestDist = dist;
				nearestClosestPoint = closestPoint;
				nearestNormal = normal;
				isCollided = true;
			}
		}
		
		// 繝ｫ繝ｼ繝励ｒ謚懊￠縺溷ｾ後∝沂縺ｾ縺｣縺ｦ豁ｻ繧薙□蠑ｾ縺ｯ蜃ｦ逅・＠縺ｪ縺・
		if (bullet->IsDead()) continue;

		if (isCollided) {
			bulletPos = nearestClosestPoint + nearestNormal * (radius + 0.01f);

			Vector3 vel = bullet->GetMove();
			vel = vel - 2.0f * Dot(vel, nearestNormal) * nearestNormal;

			if (bullet->IsReflectable()) {

				bullet->SetVelocity(vel);
				bullet->SetWorldPosition(bulletPos);
			} else {
				// 蜿榊ｰ・＠縺ｪ縺・ｼｾ縺ｯ豸域ｻ・
				bullet->SetWorldPosition(bulletPos);
				bullet->Die();
			}
		}
	}
}

void Stage::ResolvePlayerCollisionSphere(Player& player)
{
	Sphere sphere = player.GetSphere();
	Vector3 pos = sphere.center;
	Vector3 vel = player.GetMove();

	for (const auto& line : blocks_) {
		for (const Block& block : line) {
			if (!block.isActive) continue;

			// 縺薙％縺ｧ Sphere vs OBB
			CollisionResult hit =
				CheckSphereVsOBB(sphere, block.obb);

			if (!hit.hit) continue;

			// 謚ｼ縺玲綾縺・
			pos += hit.normal * hit.depth;

			// 豕慕ｷ壽婿蜷代・騾溷ｺｦ繧呈ｶ医☆・域ｻ代ｉ縺ｪ縺・ｼ・
			float vn = Dot(vel, hit.normal);
			if (vn < 0.0f) {
				vel -= hit.normal * vn;
			}

			// 謗･蝨ｰ蛻､螳・
			if (Dot(hit.normal, Vector3(0, 1, 0)) > 0.7f) {
				player.SetOnGround(true);
			}

			// 譖ｴ譁ｰ
			sphere.center = pos;
		}
	}

	player.SetWorldPosition(pos);
	player.SetVelocity(vel);
}

void Stage::ResolvePlayerCollisionSphereY(Player& player)
{
	Sphere sphere = player.GetSphere();
	Vector3 pos = sphere.center;
	Vector3 vel = player.GetMove();

	//player.SetOnGround(false);

	for (const auto& line : blocks_) {
		for (const Block& block : line) {
			if (!block.isActive) continue;

			CollisionResult hit = CheckSphereVsOBB(sphere, block.obb);
			if (!hit.hit) continue;

			float upDot = Dot(hit.normal, Vector3(0, 1, 0));

			// 縺ｻ縺ｼ蠎・or 螟ｩ莠輔→縺励※謇ｱ縺医ｋ蝣ｴ蜷・
			if (upDot > 0.7f || upDot < -0.7f) {

				// 謚ｼ縺玲綾縺暦ｼ・謌仙・縺縺托ｼ・
				pos.y += hit.normal.y * hit.depth;

				// Y譁ｹ蜷代・騾溷ｺｦ繧呈ｭ｢繧√ｋ
				if (vel.y * hit.normal.y < 0.0f) {
					vel.y = 0.0f;
				}

				// 謗･蝨ｰ蛻､螳夲ｼ亥ｺ翫・縺ｿ・・
				//if (upDot > 0.7f) {
				//	player.SetOnGround(true);
				//}

				sphere.center = pos;
			}
		}
	}

	player.SetWorldPosition(pos);
	player.SetVelocity(vel);
}
void Stage::ResolvePlayerCollisionSphereX(Player& player)
{
	Sphere sphere = player.GetSphere();
	Vector3 pos = sphere.center;
	Vector3 vel = player.GetMove();

	for (const auto& line : blocks_) {
		for (const Block& block : line) {
			if (!block.isActive) continue;

			CollisionResult hit = CheckSphereVsOBB(sphere, block.obb);
			if (!hit.hit) continue;

			// 讓ｪ謌仙・縺ｮ縺ｿ菴ｿ縺・
			Vector3 lateralNormal = hit.normal;
			lateralNormal.y = 0.0f;

			float lenSq = Dot(lateralNormal, lateralNormal);
			if (lenSq < 0.0001f) continue;

			lateralNormal = Normalize(lateralNormal);

			// 謚ｼ縺玲綾縺暦ｼ・譁ｹ蜷托ｼ・
			pos += lateralNormal * hit.depth;

			// 讓ｪ騾溷ｺｦ繧呈ｭ｢繧√ｋ
			float vn = Dot(vel, lateralNormal);
			if (vn < 0.0f) {
				vel -= lateralNormal * vn;
			}

			sphere.center = pos;
		}
	}

	player.SetWorldPosition(pos);
	player.SetVelocity(vel);
}

bool Stage::IsCollisionWithAnyBlock(const Vector3& pos, float radius) {
	Sphere spawnSphere = { pos, radius };
	for (const auto& line : blocks_) {
		for (const Block& block : line) {
			if (!block.isActive) continue;
			// 譌｢蟄倥・蛻､螳夐未謨ｰ・・heckSphereVsOBB・峨ｒ蛻ｩ逕ｨ
			CollisionResult hit = CheckSphereVsOBB(spawnSphere, block.obb);
			if (hit.hit) {
				return true; // 螢√↓蠖薙◆縺｣縺ｦ縺・ｋ
			}
		}
	}
	return false; // 螳牙・
}

const std::vector<MergedBlock>& Stage::GetMergedBlocks() const
{
	return mergedBlocks_;
}

const std::vector<std::vector<Block>>& Stage::GetBlocks() const {
	return blocks_;
}

	std::vector<std::vector<Block>> blocks_;

	std::unique_ptr<MapChip> mapChip_ = nullptr;

	std::vector<MergedBlock> mergedBlocks_;

	float dt_ = 0;
};

#include "Fade.h"
#include <algorithm>

void Fade::Initialize() {

	sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	sprite->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/fade.png");

}

void Fade::Update() {

	sprite->Update();

	//繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝臥憾諷九↓繧医ｋ蛻・ｲ・
	switch (status_) {
	case Status::None:

		break;
	case Status::FadeIn:
		// 1繝輔Ξ繝ｼ繝蛻・・遘呈焚繧偵き繧ｦ繝ｳ繝医い繝・・
		counter_ += 1.0f / 60.0f;
		// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝臥ｶ咏ｶ壽凾髢薙↓驕斐＠縺溘ｉ謇薙■豁｢繧・
		if (counter_ >= duration_) {
			counter_ = duration_;
		}
		// 0.0f縺九ｉ1.0f縺ｮ髢薙〒縲∫ｵ碁℃譎る俣縺後ヵ繧ｧ繝ｼ繝臥ｶ咏ｶ壽凾髢薙↓霑代▼縺上⊇縺ｩ繧｢繝ｫ繝輔ぃ蛟､繧貞､ｧ縺阪￥縺吶ｋ
		sprite->SetColor(Vector4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, std::clamp(1.0f - counter_ / duration_, 0.0f, 1.0f)));

		break;
	case Status::FadeOut:
		// 1繝輔Ξ繝ｼ繝蛻・・遘呈焚繧偵き繧ｦ繝ｳ繝医い繝・・
		counter_ += 1.0f / 60.0f;
		// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝臥ｶ咏ｶ壽凾髢薙↓驕斐＠縺溘ｉ謇薙■豁｢繧・
		if (counter_ >= duration_) {
			counter_ = duration_;
		}
		// 0.0f縺九ｉ1.0f縺ｮ髢薙〒縲∫ｵ碁℃譎る俣縺後ヵ繧ｧ繝ｼ繝臥ｶ咏ｶ壽凾髢薙↓霑代▼縺上⊇縺ｩ繧｢繝ｫ繝輔ぃ蛟､繧貞､ｧ縺阪￥縺吶ｋ
		sprite->SetColor(Vector4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, std::clamp(counter_ / duration_, 0.0f, 1.0f)));
		break;
	}
}

void Fade::Draw() {
	if (status_ == Status::None) {
		return;
	}
	sprite->Draw();
}

// 02_13 18譫夂岼 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝蛾幕蟋・
void Fade::Start(Status status, float duration) {
	status_ = status;
	duration_ = duration;
	counter_ = 0.0f;
}

// 02_13 24譫夂岼 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝牙●豁｢
void Fade::Stop() { status_ = Status::None; }

// 02_13 26譫夂岼 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝臥ｵゆｺ・愛螳・
bool Fade::IsFinished() const {

	// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝臥憾諷九↓繧医ｋ蛻・ｲ・
	switch (status_) {
	case Status::FadeIn:
	case Status::FadeOut:
		/*
				if (counter_ >= duration_) {
					return true;
				}
				else {
					return false;
				}
		*/
		// 1陦後ヰ繝ｼ繧ｸ繝ｧ繝ｳ 3鬆・ｼ皮ｮ怜ｭ・
		return (counter_ >= duration_) ? true : false;
	}

	return true;
}

// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\scene\Fade.h

#pragma once
#include "Struct.h"
#include "Sprite.h"

class Fade {
public:
	enum class Status {
		None,    // 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨↑縺・
		FadeIn,  // 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨う繝ｳ荳ｭ
		FadeOut, // 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨い繧ｦ繝井ｸｭ
	};

	void Initialize();
	void Update();
	void Draw();

	// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝蛾幕蟋・
	void Start(Status status, float duration);

	// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝牙●豁｢
	void Stop();

	// 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝臥ｵゆｺ・愛螳・
	bool IsFinished() const;

private:
	std::unique_ptr<Sprite> sprite;

	// 02_13 16譫夂岼 迴ｾ蝨ｨ縺ｮ繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨・迥ｶ諷・
	Status status_ = Status::None;

	// 02_13 17譫夂岼 繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繝峨・謖∫ｶ壽凾髢・
	float duration_ = 0.0f;
	// 02_13 17譫夂岼 邨碁℃譎る俣繧ｫ繧ｦ繝ｳ繧ｿ繝ｼ
	float counter_ = 0.0f;
};

void Game::Run() {
    MainLoop();
}

void Game::MainLoop() {

    MSG msg{};
    while (msg.message != WM_QUIT) {

        if (PeekMessage(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessage(&msg);
            continue;
        }
        // 繧､繝ｳ繝励ャ繝医う繝ｳ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝ｳ繧ｹ繧貞叙蠕・
        Input* input = Input::GetInstance();

        // 蜑阪・繝輔Ξ繝ｼ繝縺ｮ繧ｭ繝ｼ迥ｶ諷九ｒ菫晏ｭ・
        input->BeforeFrameData();

#ifdef USE_IMGUI

        ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
        ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
        ImGui::NewFrame();

#endif // USE_IMGUI

        bloom_->Update();

        if (input->IsPress(input->GetKey()[DIK_LSHIFT]) && input->IsTrigger(input->GetKey()[DIK_D], input->GetPreKey()[DIK_D])) {
            if (Object3dCommon::GetInstance()->GetIsDebugCamera()) {
                Object3dCommon::GetInstance()->SetIsDebugCamera(false);
            } else {
                Object3dCommon::GetInstance()->SetIsDebugCamera(true);
            }
        }

        Object3dCommon::GetInstance()->Update();
        SceneManager::GetInstance()->Update();
        
#ifdef USE_IMGUI
        // ImGui縺ｮ蜀・Κ繧ｳ繝槭Φ繝峨ｒ逕滓・縺吶ｋ
        ImGui::Render();

#endif // USE_IMGUI

        dxCommon_->PreDraw(); // 繝舌ャ繧ｯ繝舌ャ繝輔ぃ縺ｮ繝舌Μ繧｢縺ｯ縺薙％縺ｧ陦後ｏ繧後※縺・ｋ
        srvManager_->PreDraw();
       
        shadow_->PreDraw();
        
        bloom_->PreDraw();
        
        SceneManager::GetInstance()->DrawPostEffect3D(); // 縺薙％縺ｧ Object3d::Draw 縺悟他縺ｰ繧後ｋ
        
        SpriteCommon::GetInstance()->PreDraw(kNone);
        SceneManager::GetInstance()->DrawSprite();
        
        bloom_->PostDraw();


#ifdef USE_IMGUI
        // 螳滄圀縺ｮcommandList縺ｮImGui縺ｮ謠冗判繧ｳ繝槭Φ繝峨ｒ邨・・
        ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), dxCommon_->GetList().Get());

#endif // USE_IMGUI
        
        dxCommon_->PostDraw();
    }
}

void Game::Finalize() {

#ifdef USE_IMGUI
    // 螳滄圀縺ｮcommandList縺ｮImGui縺ｮ謠冗判繧ｳ繝槭Φ繝峨ｒ邨・・
    ImGui_ImplDX12_Shutdown();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_Shutdown();
    ImGui::DestroyContext();

#endif // USE_IMGUI

    TextureManager::GetInstance()->Finalize();
    ModelManager::GetInstance()->Finalize();

    CloseHandle(dxCommon_->GetFenceEvent());

    dxCommon_->Release();
    WinApp::GetInstance()->Finalize();

    CoUninitialize();
    MFShutdown();
}

void GameScene::Update() {
	
	// 騾壼ｸｸ縺ｯ 1/60遘・
	float baseDeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;

	// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺後せ繝ｭ繝ｼ繧定ｦ∵ｱゅ＠縺ｦ縺・◆繧・timeScale 繧剃ｸ九￡繧・
	if (player_->RequestSlow()) {
		timeScale_ = 0.01f; // 100蛟阪せ繝ｭ繝ｼ
	}

	// 蠕舌・↓蜈・・譎る俣・・.0・峨↓謌ｻ縺励※縺・￥蜃ｦ逅・ｼ・erp・・
	timeScale_ += (1.0f - timeScale_) * 0.03f;

	// 譛邨ら噪縺ｪ deltaTime
	finalDeltaTime = baseDeltaTime * timeScale_;
	// 荳螳壹∪縺ｧ騾溷ｺｦ縺梧綾縺｣縺溘ｉ螳悟・縺ｫ謌ｻ縺・
	if (finalDeltaTime * 60.0f > 0.95f) {
		finalDeltaTime = baseDeltaTime;
	}

	if (player_->IsChangeMode()) {
		finalDeltaTime = 0.0f;
	}

#ifdef USE_IMGUI

	ImGui::Begin("FPS");
	ImGui::Text("FPS: %.2f", ImGui::GetIO().Framerate);
	ImGui::Text("deltaTime: %.8f", finalDeltaTime * 60.0f);
	ImGui::End();
	
	ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(100, 100), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
	ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(500, 100), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);

	ImGui::Begin("Sprite");
	ImGui::SliderFloat2("position", &shotGide->GetPosition().x, 0.0f, 3000.0f, "%.1f");
	ImGui::End();

	ImGui::Begin("ballScale");
	ImGui::DragFloat3("scale", &ball_->GetScale().x);
	ImGui::End();

	ImGui::Begin("Color");
	ImGui::DragFloat3("scale", &ball_->GetScale().x);
	ImGui::ColorEdit4("color", &ball_->GetColor().x);
	ImGui::End();

#endif // USE_IMGUI

	camera->Update();
	debugCamera->Update(input_->GetMouseState(), input_->GetKey(), input_->GetLeftStick());
	

	direction = Normalize(direction);
	ball_->SetDirectionalLightDirection(direction);
	ball_->SetInsensity(insensity);
	ball_->SetShininess(shininess);

	//worldTransform_.translate.y += 0.01f;


	//ballObj_->SetTranslate(worldTransform_.translate);
	ballObj_->Update();
	ball_->Update();
	groundObj_->Update();

	stage_->Update();
	
	player_->Update(camera.get(), *stage_, bulletManager_.get(), finalDeltaTime);
	
	enemy_->Update(finalDeltaTime);

	//enemyManager_->Update(*stage_, finalDeltaTime);
	
	bulletManager_->Update(*stage_, finalDeltaTime);
	
	// 陦晉ｪ√・繝阪・繧ｸ繝｣縺ｮ譖ｴ譁ｰ
	//collisionManager_->CheckAllCollisions(player_.get(), enemy_.get(), bulletManager_.get(), enemyManager_.get());
	collisionManager_->CheckAllCollisions(player_.get(), enemy_.get(), bulletManager_.get());

#ifdef USE_IMGUI

	ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();

	// 繧｢繝励Μ蛛ｴ縺ｮ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝・け蜃ｦ逅・ｒ陦後≧蜑阪↓繝√ぉ繝・け
	if (!io.WantCaptureMouse) {
		// 蟾ｦ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝・け縺励◆繧峨ヱ繝ｼ繝・ぅ繧ｯ繝ｫ霑ｽ蜉
		if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
			for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 100; ++index) {

				Vector3 worldPos = ScreenToWorld3D(input_->GetMousePosition(), debugCamera->GetViewMatrix(), MakePerspectiveForMatrix(0.45f, float(WinApp::kClientWidth) / float(WinApp::kClientHeight), 0.1f, 100.0f), WinApp::kClientWidth, WinApp::kClientHeight, debugCamera->GetDistance());
				ParticleManager::GetInstance()->Emit(MakeParticle(worldPos, Rand()));
			}
		}
	}

#endif // USE_IMGUI

	ParticleManager::GetInstance()->Update(finalDeltaTime, camera.get(), debugCamera.get());

	switch (phase_) {
	case Phase::kFadeIn:
		fade_->Update();
	
		if (fade_->IsFinished()) {
			phase_ = Phase::kMain;
		}
		break;
	case Phase::kMain:
		if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetKey()[DIK_ESCAPE], input_->GetPreKey()[DIK_ESCAPE])) {
			fade_->Start(Fade::Status::FadeOut, 1.0f);
			phase_ = Phase::kFadeOut;
		}
	
		if (player_->isFinished()) {
			fade_->Start(Fade::Status::FadeOut, 1.0f);
			phase_ = Phase::kFadeOut;
		}
	
		if (enemy_->isFinished()) {
			fade_->Start(Fade::Status::FadeOut, 1.0f);
			phase_ = Phase::kFadeOut;
		}
	
		break;
	case Phase::kFadeOut:
		fade_->Update();
		if (fade_->IsFinished()) {
			finished_ = true;
		}
		break;
	}
	
	shotGide->Update();
	wasdGide->Update();
	dashGide->Update();
	toTitleGide->Update();
	
	if (cameraFollow_) {
	
		// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺梧ｭｻ繧薙〒縺・ｋ蝣ｴ蜷医き繝｡繝ｩ繧偵・繝ｬ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｫ蜷医ｏ縺帙ｋ
		if (player_->IsDead()) {
			Vector3 playerPos = player_->GetWorldPosition();
			camera->SetTranslate({ playerPos.x, playerPos.y, -50.0f });
			cameraFollow_ = false;
		}
	
		// 謨ｵ縺梧ｭｻ繧薙〒縺・ｋ蝣ｴ蜷医き繝｡繝ｩ繧呈雰縺ｫ蜷医ｏ縺帙ｋ
		if (enemy_->IsDead()) {
			Vector3 enemyPos = enemy_->GetWorldPosition();
			camera->SetTranslate({ enemyPos.x, enemyPos.y, -50.0f });
			cameraFollow_ = false;
		}
	}
}

#pragma once
#include <string>

class IScene {
public:
    virtual ~IScene() = default;
    virtual void Initialize() = 0;
    virtual void Update() = 0;
    virtual void Draw() = 0;
    virtual void DrawShadow() {}
    virtual void DrawPostEffect3D() {}
    virtual void DrawSprite() = 0;
	virtual float GetFinalDeltaTime() const { return 1.0f / 60.0f; } // 繝・ヵ繧ｩ繝ｫ繝医・60FPS 

    // 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ邨ゆｺ・愛螳夲ｼ・ceneManager縺後メ繧ｧ繝・け縺吶ｋ・・
    virtual bool IsFinished() const = 0;

    virtual std::string GetNextSceneName() const { return ""; }
};

// ==================================================
// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\scene\SceneFactory.h
// ==================================================

#include "AbstractSceneFactory.h"
#include "TitleScene.h"
#include "GameScene.h"
#include "TestScene.h"

class SceneFactory : public AbstractSceneFactory {
public:
    std::unique_ptr<IScene> CreateScene(const std::string& sceneName) override {
        if (sceneName == "TITLE") return std::make_unique<TitleScene>();
        if (sceneName == "TEST")  return std::make_unique<TestScene>();
        if (sceneName == "GAME")  return std::make_unique<GameScene>();
        return nullptr;
    }
};

// ==================================================
// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\scene\SceneManager.cpp
// ==================================================

#include "SceneManager.h"
#include "SceneFactory.h"

SceneManager* SceneManager::GetInstance()
{
    static SceneManager instance;
    return &instance;
}

void SceneManager::Initialize(const std::string& firstSceneName) {

    // Factory 縺ｮ逕滓・
    sceneFactory_ = std::make_unique<SceneFactory>();

    // 譛蛻昴・繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ繧堤函謌・
    currentScene_ = sceneFactory_->CreateScene(firstSceneName);
    currentScene_->Initialize();
}

void SceneManager::Update() {
    // 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ縺檎ｵゆｺ・＠縺ｦ縺・◆繧牙・繧頑崛縺・
    if (currentScene_->IsFinished()) {
        // 谺｡縺ｮ繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蜷阪ｒ繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ閾ｪ霄ｫ縺九ｉ蜿門ｾ励☆繧・
        std::string nextSceneName = currentScene_->GetNextSceneName();

        // Factory 縺ｫ譁ｰ縺励＞繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ繧剃ｽ懊▲縺ｦ繧ゅｉ縺・
        // 縺薙％縺ｧ SceneManager 縺ｯ縲御ｽ輔′菴懊ｉ繧後ｋ縺九阪ｒ蜈ｷ菴鍋噪縺ｫ遏･繧峨↑縺上※貂医・
        std::unique_ptr<IScene> nextScene = sceneFactory_->CreateScene(nextSceneName);

        if (nextScene) {
            currentScene_ = std::move(nextScene);
            currentScene_->Initialize();
        }
    }

    currentScene_->Update();
}

void SceneManager::Draw() {
    currentScene_->Draw();
}

void SceneManager::DrawShadow() {
    currentScene_->DrawShadow();
}

void SceneManager::DrawPostEffect3D() {
    currentScene_->DrawPostEffect3D();
}

void SceneManager::DrawSprite() {
    currentScene_->DrawSprite();
}
float SceneManager::GetFinalDeltaTime()
{
	return currentScene_->GetFinalDeltaTime();
}

	swordObj_ = std::make_unique<Object3d>();
	swordObj_->Initialize();
	swordObj_->SetModel("weapon.obj"); // 譌｢蟄倥・繝｢繝・Ν
	swordObj_->SetScale({ 2.0f, 2.0f, 2.0f }); // 蜑｣縺｣縺ｽ縺冗ｴｰ髟ｷ縺・

void TestScene::Update() {

#ifdef USE_IMGUI

	ImGui::Begin("FPS");
	ImGui::Text("FPS: %.2f", ImGui::GetIO().Framerate);
	ImGui::Text("deltaTime: %.8f", finalDeltaTime * 60.0f);
	ImGui::End();

	ImGui::Begin("Block");
	ImGui::DragFloat3("position", &blockObj_->GetTranslate().x);
	ImGui::DragFloat3("scale", &blockObj_->GetScale().x);
	ImGui::End();

	ImGui::Begin("Ground");
	ImGui::DragFloat3("position", &groundObj_->GetTranslate().x);
	ImGui::DragFloat3("rotate", &groundObj_->GetRotate().x, 0.01f);
	ImGui::End();

#endif // USE_IMGUI

	// 1. 蜑｣繧偵・繧灘屓縺吶い繝九Γ繝ｼ繧ｷ繝ｧ繝ｳ・医ユ繧ｹ繝育畑・・
	static float timer = 0.0f;
	timer += 0.02f;
	swordObj_->SetRotate({ 0.0f, 0.0f, timer * 2.0f }); // Z霆ｸ縺ｧ縺舌ｋ縺舌ｋ
	//swordObj_->SetTranslate({ std::sin(timer) * 20.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f }); // 蟾ｦ蜿ｳ縺ｫ謠ｺ繧峨☆
	swordObj_->Update();

	// 2. 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝芽｡悟・縺九ｉ蜈育ｫｯ縺ｨ譬ｹ蜈・・蠎ｧ讓吶ｒ險育ｮ・
	// 窶ｻObject3d縺ｫ GetWorldMatrix() 縺後≠繧句燕謠舌ゅ↑縺代ｌ縺ｰ險育ｮ励＠縺ｦ縺上□縺輔＞
	Matrix4x4 worldMat = MakeAffineMatrix(swordObj_->GetScale(), swordObj_->GetRotate(), swordObj_->GetTranslate());

	Vector3 localBase = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };   // 蜑｣縺ｮ譬ｹ蜈・
	Vector3 localTip = { 0.0f, 6.0f, 0.0f };  // 蜑｣縺ｮ蜈育ｫｯ・・cale.y縺・0縺ｪ繧峨％縺ｮ縺ゅ◆繧奇ｼ・

	// 繝ｭ繝ｼ繧ｫ繝ｫ蠎ｧ讓吶ｒ繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝牙ｺｧ讓吶∈螟画鋤
	Vector3 worldBase = TransformNormal(localBase, worldMat);
	Vector3 worldTip = TransformNormal(localTip, worldMat);

	// 3. 霆瑚ｷ｡繧呈峩譁ｰ・・
	//trailManager_->Update(worldTip, worldBase);

	camera->Update();
	debugCamera->Update(input_->GetMouseState(), input_->GetKey(), input_->GetLeftStick());
	groundObj_->Update();
	blockObj_->Update();
	//swordObj_->Update();

#ifdef USE_IMGUI

	ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();

	// 繧｢繝励Μ蛛ｴ縺ｮ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝・け蜃ｦ逅・ｒ陦後≧蜑阪↓繝√ぉ繝・け
	if (!io.WantCaptureMouse) {
		// 蟾ｦ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝・け縺励◆繧峨ヱ繝ｼ繝・ぅ繧ｯ繝ｫ霑ｽ蜉
		if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
			for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 100; ++index) {

				Vector3 worldPos = ScreenToWorld3D(input_->GetMousePosition(), debugCamera->GetViewMatrix(), MakePerspectiveForMatrix(0.45f, float(WinApp::kClientWidth) / float(WinApp::kClientHeight), 0.1f, 100.0f), WinApp::kClientWidth, WinApp::kClientHeight, debugCamera->GetDistance());
				ParticleManager::GetInstance()->Emit(MakeParticle(worldPos, Rand()));
			}
		}
	}

#endif // USE_IMGUI

	ParticleManager::GetInstance()->Update(finalDeltaTime, camera.get(), debugCamera.get());

}

// File: C:\Users\k024g\OneDrive\デスクトップ\自作エンジン\CG3\project\game\scene\TitleScene.cpp

#include "TitleScene.h"
#include <numbers>

void TitleScene::Initialize() {

	input_ = Input::GetInstance();

	camera = std::make_unique<Camera>();
	camera->SetTranslate(Vector3(17.0f, 21.0f, -80.0f));

	fade_ = std::make_unique<Fade>();
	fade_->Initialize();
	fade_->Start(Fade::Status::FadeIn, 1.0f);

	const float screenW = 1280.0f;
	const float screenH = 720.0f;

	const int charCount = 8;

	// 譁・ｭ励し繧､繧ｺ・井ｻｮ縺ｫ邨ｱ荳・・
	const Vector2 charSize = { 96.0f, 96.0f };

	// 讓ｪ蟷・ｨ育ｮ・竊・荳ｭ螟ｮ蟇・○
	const float spacing = charSize.x * 0.9f;
	const float totalWidth = spacing * (charCount - 1);
	const float baseX = screenW * 0.5f - totalWidth * 0.5f;

	// Y菴咲ｽｮ
	float startY = -charSize.y - 50.0f;          // 逕ｻ髱｢螟・
	const float targetY = screenH * 0.35f;              // 逕ｻ髱｢荳ｭ螟ｮ繧医ｊ蟆代＠荳・

	std::vector<std::string> files = {
		"ta.png","ta.png","ka.png","u.png",
		"se.png","nn.png","si.png","ya.png"
	};

	for (int i = 0; i < charCount; ++i) {

		LogoChar c{};
		c.sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
		c.sprite->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/" + files[i]);
		c.sprite->SetAnchorPoint({ 0.5f, 0.5f });

		// 繧ｵ繧､繧ｺ險ｭ螳・
		c.sprite->SetSize(charSize);
		c.baseSize = charSize;

		// X縺ｯ遲蛾俣髫・+ 蠕ｮ繝ｩ繝ｳ繝繝
		float x = baseX + spacing * i + Rand(-6.0f, 6.0f);

		// 髢句ｧ倶ｽ咲ｽｮ縺ｯ蟆代＠鬮倥＆繧偵ヰ繝ｩ縺・
		c.startPos = {
			x,
			startY + Rand(-50.0f, 50.0f)
		};

		c.targetPos = {
			x,
			targetY + Rand(-8.0f, 8.0f)
		};

		c.sprite->SetPosition(c.startPos);

		// 關ｽ荳九せ繝斐・繝峨↓蛟区ｧ繧貞・縺・
		c.fallSpeed = Rand(550.0f, 750.0f);

		// 繧ｿ繧､繝溘Φ繧ｰ縺壹ｉ縺暦ｼ亥ｰ代＠繝ｩ繝ｳ繝繝・・
		c.delay = i * 0.12f + Rand(0.0f, 0.05f);

		c.timer = 0.0f;
		c.landed = false;

		logoChars.push_back(std::move(c));
	}

	// 繝ｭ繧ｴ縺ｮ蟆代＠荳・
	startY = screenH * 0.55f + 120.0f;

	startLogo.sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	startLogo.sprite->Initialize(
		SpriteCommon::GetInstance(),
		"resources/start.png"
	);
	startLogo.sprite->SetAnchorPoint({ 0.5f, 0.5f });

	// 繧ｵ繧､繧ｺ
	startLogo.sprite->SetSize({ 320.0f, 64.0f });
	startLogo.baseSize = startLogo.sprite->GetSize();

	// 菴咲ｽｮ
	startLogo.startPos = { screenW * 0.5f, -100.0f };
	startLogo.targetPos = { screenW * 0.5f, startY };
	startLogo.sprite->SetPosition(startLogo.startPos);

	// 繝ｭ繧ｴ繧医ｊ蟆代＠驕・ｌ縺ｦ關ｽ縺｡繧・
	startLogo.delay = 8 * 0.12f + 0.2f;
	startLogo.fallSpeed = 700.0f;

	startLogo.timer = 0.0f;
	startLogo.landed = false;

	// 繝ｭ繧ｴ縺ｮ蟆代＠荳・
	startY = screenH * 0.45f + 120.0f;

	ruleLogo.sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	ruleLogo.sprite->Initialize(
		SpriteCommon::GetInstance(),
		"resources/toRule.png"
	);
	ruleLogo.sprite->SetAnchorPoint({ 0.5f, 0.5f });

	// 繧ｵ繧､繧ｺ
	ruleLogo.sprite->SetSize({ 320.0f, 64.0f });
	ruleLogo.baseSize = ruleLogo.sprite->GetSize();

	// 菴咲ｽｮ
	ruleLogo.startPos = { screenW * 0.5f, -100.0f };
	ruleLogo.targetPos = { screenW * 0.5f, startY };
	ruleLogo.sprite->SetPosition(ruleLogo.startPos);

	// 繝ｭ繧ｴ繧医ｊ蟆代＠驕・ｌ縺ｦ關ｽ縺｡繧・
	ruleLogo.delay = 9 * 0.12f + 0.2f;
	ruleLogo.fallSpeed = 700.0f;

	ruleLogo.timer = 0.0f;
	ruleLogo.landed = false;

	rule = std::make_unique<Sprite>();
	rule->Initialize(SpriteCommon::GetInstance(), "resources/rule.png");
	rule->SetPosition({ 640.0f, 360.0f });
	rule->SetAnchorPoint({ 0.5f,0.5f });
	rule->SetAlpha(0.50f);
}

void TitleScene::Update() {

	for (auto& c : logoChars) {
		UpdateLogoChar(c, deltaTime);
	}

	UpdateLogoChar(startLogo, deltaTime);
	UpdateLogoChar(ruleLogo, deltaTime);
	rule->Update();

	switch (phase_) {
	case Phase::kFadeIn:
		fade_->Update();

		if (fade_->IsFinished()) {
			phase_ = Phase::kMain;
		}
		break;
	case Phase::kMain:

		// 蟾ｦ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝・け縺ｧrule繧定｡ｨ遉ｺ
		if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
			if (ruleGide) {
				if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
					fade_->Start(Fade::Status::FadeOut, 1.0f);
					phase_ = Phase::kFadeOut;
					ruleGide = false;
				}
			} else {
				ruleGide = true;
			}
		}

		//if (!ruleGide) {
		//	if (input_->IsTrigger(input_->GetMouseState().rgbButtons[0], input_->GetPreMouseState().rgbButtons[0])) {
		//		fade_->Start(Fade::Status::FadeOut, 1.0f);
		//		phase_ = Phase::kFadeOut;
		//	}
		//}
		break;
	case Phase::kFadeOut:
		fade_->Update();
		if (fade_->IsFinished()) {
			finished_ = true;
		}
		break;
	}
};

void TitleScene::Draw() {};

void TitleScene::DrawSprite() {
	//sprite_->Draw();
	for (auto& c : logoChars) {
		c.sprite->Draw();
	}
	startLogo.sprite->Draw();
	//ruleLogo.sprite->Draw();
	fade_->Draw();

	if (ruleGide) {
		rule->Draw();
	}
}

void TitleScene::UpdateLogoChar(LogoChar& c, float deltaTime)
{
	c.timer += deltaTime;
	if (c.timer < c.delay) return;

	Vector2 pos = c.sprite->GetPosition();

	if (!c.landed) {
		pos.y += c.fallSpeed * deltaTime;
		if (pos.y >= c.targetPos.y) {
			pos.y = c.targetPos.y;
			c.landed = true;
			c.timer = 0.0f;
		}
	} else {
		float t = c.timer * 4.0f;
		float scale = 1.0f + std::sin(t) * 0.12f;

		c.sprite->SetSize({
			c.baseSize.x * scale,
			c.baseSize.y * scale
			});
	}

	c.sprite->SetPosition(pos);
	c.sprite->Update();
}

std::string TitleScene::GetNextSceneName() const
{
	return "GAME";
}

		Vector2 startPos;
		Vector2 targetPos;

		Vector2 baseSize;
		float timer;
		float delay;
		float fallSpeed;
		bool landed;
	};

	void Initialize() override;

	void Update() override;

	void Draw() override;
	void DrawSprite() override;

	// 繝・せ繝輔Λ繧ｰ縺ｮgetter
	bool IsFinished() const override { return finished_; }
	void UpdateLogoChar(LogoChar& c, float deltaTime);

	std::string GetNextSceneName() const override;

private:
	// 繝薙Η繝ｼ繝励Ο繧ｸ繧ｧ繧ｯ繧ｷ繝ｧ繝ｳ
	std::unique_ptr<Camera> camera;

	// 邨ゆｺ・ヵ繝ｩ繧ｰ
	bool finished_ = false;

	// 繧ｹ繝励Λ繧､繝・
	std::unique_ptr<Sprite> rule;


	// 轤ｹ貊・畑繧ｿ繧､繝槭・
	float blinkTimer_ = 0.0f;

	//Fade
	std::unique_ptr<Fade> fade_ = nullptr;
	Phase phase_ = Phase::kFadeIn;

	// 蜈･蜉・
	Input* input_;

	std::vector<LogoChar> logoChars;

	const float deltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;

	LogoChar startLogo;
	bool startVisible = false;
	LogoChar ruleLogo;
	bool startVisibleRule = false;

	bool ruleGide = false;
};
